This session will wrap up with a look at the latest roadmap updates.

speakers.name: Kent Marten
speakers.bio: Kent has been a speaker at Data +AI summit on 4 previous occasions; as the PM for the SQL Surface area and Geospatial at Databricks.

sessions.title: Speed at Scale on the Lakehouse
sessions.body: Everyone wants reports that reflect what’s happening now and respond rapidly under load. In this session, we’ll show how Databricks delivers end-to-end high-speed analytics on the Lakehouse, from BI serving to operational analytics.

speakers.name: Jeremy Lewallen
speakers.bio: Jeremy Lewallen is a Senior Staff Product Manager on Performance.

speakers.name: Mostafa Mokhtar
speakers.bio: Principal Performance Engineer and technical lead for Databricks.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Acceldata | Trust at the Speed of Agents: Reliable AI and Data on Databricks
sessions.body: As enterprises deploy AI agents across Databricks at unprecedented pace, trust at production speed requires a complete trust platform. This session covers how Acceldata integrates three layers — data observability, agentic data management, and Agent Observability — into a single operating model for reliable AI on Databricks. Each layer reinforces the next: observability without action is alerting, action without observability is guessing, and agents without governance is risk. From anomaly detection through autonomous remediation to agent trust, this approach points toward the self-governing lakehouse where data, agents, and policies stay in lockstep without humans in every decision.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Accenture | Accelerating Financial Close with SAP Databricks - AI-Driven Finance Transformation
sessions.body: For decades, the Financial Close has been one of the most time consuming, manually intensive, and risk prone processes within the finance function. Today, that reality is rapidly changing. With the convergence of SAP Business Data Cloud (BDC) and the AI/ML capabilities of SAP Databricks, finance organizations are re-architecting their close cycles - shifting from reactive reporting to proactive, insight driven decisioning. Accenture’s adoption of SAP Databricks as the AI and data science backbone for Financial Close operations represents a major leap forward. Working hand in hand with SAP & Databricks, the ecosystem has been engineered to support predictive insights, automated commentaries, real time monitoring, and fully integrated treasury operations. This transformation isn’t just technological - it delivers tangible, measurable business impact. This presentation highlights the KPIs and metrics that demonstrate how SAP Databricks reshapes the Financial Close process end-to-end.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Accenture | From Pipelines to Agents: Rethinking Data Engineering for Autonomous Systems
sessions.body: The next evolution of data engineering isn’t incremental—it’s autonomous. In this session, we challenge the traditional notion of pipelines and introduce an agentic model where data systems can reason, adapt, and act. Using Databricks as the foundation, we explore how agentic AI enables dynamic orchestration, intelligent error handling, and continuous optimization across the data lifecycle to build and run a complete data intelligence platform. We’ll share practical design patterns, lessons learned, and the trade-offs organizations must navigate as they move toward self-evolving data platforms—balancing autonomy with control, and innovation with governance.

speakers.name: Abderrahmane FILALI
speakers.bio: Abderrahmane Filali is a Data & Cloud Specialist at Avanade Accenture with over a decade of experience building and scaling modern data platforms. He specializes in data engineering and cloud architecture across Manufacturing and Financial Services, designing resilient Lakehouse solutions on Databricks that go beyond traditional pipelines — toward intelligent, self-evolving data systems that balance autonomy with governance.

speakers.name: Chintan Shah
speakers.bio: Chintan is a Group Manager in Avanade’s Data & AI COE team. Having done PhD in Underwater Acoustic Communication, he has worked in academia and various industries such as oil & gas, retail and consultancy.   As a Data Scientist, Chintan has worked on several projects which include anomaly detection, predictive maintenance, fraud detection, NLP, sales prediction, anti money laundering and segmentation using various algorithms.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Accenture | Reinventing Talent for the Human + AI Era
sessions.body: Join Accenture and industry leaders for an executive panel exploring how organizations are harnessing AI and data to transform talent strategies and unlock workforce potential. As enterprises modernize their data foundations, new opportunities are emerging to reskill talent, enhance decision-making, and drive innovation at scale. Panelists will share how they are embedding AI into talent ecosystems—redefining roles, accelerating skills development, and aligning workforce strategy to business outcomes. The discussion will also address key challenges, including change management, data readiness, and responsible AI adoption. Attendees will gain actionable insights into building a future-ready workforce powered by data and AI, and how leading organizations are turning transformation into measurable business value.

speakers.name: Shyam Thyagaraj
speakers.bio: CHRO of Services and Global Head of Talent at Accenture, Shyam sits at the intersection of people and technology—driving how organizations translate AI ambition into real business value. At Accenture, he leads the people agenda across global services—ensuring the company has the right talent, developing future-ready skills at scale, and creating an environment where people can build meaningful, long-term careers. Shyam partners with clients on AI and data transformations—helping them move beyond experimentation to execution. His focus is on aligning workforce strategy to business outcomes: redefining roles, accelerating reskilling, and embedding AI responsibly to unlock measurable impact.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Accenture | Securing America’s Scientific Future
sessions.body: Accenture and Databricks are delivering on the Genesis Mission through the creation of a unified discovery platform that will accelerate scientific discovery across labs and more broadly. In this session attendees will see how we enable this through massive-scale scientific data using governed ingestion pipelines with agentic ETL, medallion architecture, Unity Catalog, Genie for natural-language exploration, and Mosaic AI for agentic workflows, modeling, and evaluation to transform complex research data into trusted, production-ready AI capabilities.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Actian | Scaling AI: Data Products and Contracts as the Foundation
sessions.body:
Forget the models. Unstructured, unowned, uncontracted data is where AI goes to underdeliver. Most Gen AI initiatives deliver zero ROI, and Gartner expects 40% of agentic AI programs to be canceled by 2027. 

The analogy writes itself. Lufthansa Cargo doesn't ship freight without a manifest, a container, and a contract between shipper and carrier. Yet we routinely ship data to AI with none of that. Data products are the containers. Data contracts are the manifests. Open standards like ODCS and ODPS, part of the Linux Foundation's Bitol project, serve as a shared language that makes them readable across the supply chain.

You've invested in a lakehouse. But even the best Delta Lake architecture breaks down when AI agents can't verify data quality, trace lineage, or resolve ownership when something goes wrong. Your infrastructure is solid. The contract layer above it is missing. And organizations that close that gap are 3.4x more likely to put AI into production. We'll show how Lufthansa Cargo's Data Cargo Platform puts that principle into practice, unifying 100+ real-time sources into a governed foundation for operational intelligence, powered by the Actian Data Intelligence Platform, and delivering measurable ROI at enterprise scale.

Takeaways:

  • Why data products and contracts are non-negotiable for AI-ready data
  • How open standards like ODCS and ODPS de-risk AI without vendor lock-in
  • A working blueprint from Lufthansa Cargo: many sources, one platform, measurable ROI

speakers.name: Jean-Georges Perrin
speakers.bio:
Jean-Georges Perrin (“JGP”) is a Senior Product Manager at Actian, leading initiatives in Data Products and Data Contracts. With 25 years of experience in data architecture—including a tenure as Principal Architect at Expedia—he now chairs the Linux Foundation’s Bitol project, driving the Open Data Contract Standard (ODCS).

The author of Implementing Data Mesh and Spark in Action, JGP is a recognized thought leader, Lifetime IBM Champion, and Data Mesh MVP dedicated to balancing data governance with innovation.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Alteryx | The Foundation Comes First: Building a Tax Data Strategy That Scales with AI
sessions.body: AI, agents, predictive modeling, and the next wave of tax innovation depend on something deceptively simple: the right data, in the right place, ready to use. In this session, Cheria Coram, Director, Tax Technology & Data Enablement at Starbucks, shares her vision for evolving tax data strategy from reactive data wrangling to intentional foundation building. Drawing on her experience leading data and automation for a global tax function, she'll cover how Alteryx unlocked efficiency in data transformation and why the next critical unlock is centralizing, governing, and designing tax-processed data for reuse across the tax lifecycle. She'll also share where the team is headed next, using Alteryx with Databricks to build a scalable foundation that enables tax-ready modeling today and positions the team to layer on analytics, AI, and whatever comes next.

speakers.name: Cheria Coram
speakers.bio: Influential tax data and automation leader focused on reimagining the tax function, powered by data and technology, with a passion for infusing innovation into team culture and building teams and capabilities for lasting impact. Cheria Coram is Director of Tax Technology & Data Enablement at Starbucks, where she sets the vision and leads the strategy and delivery of data and automation solutions across the tax function. Her work focuses on elevating the tax data experience, enabling scalable compliance, strong controls, audit readiness, and insight-driven support of business growth. Her background includes expertise in financial accounting and reporting for taxes, SOX controls, redesigning processes, and leading tax-focused transformation efforts.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Amperity | GOAL! How Amperity Helped Seattle Sounders & Baltimore Ravens Fan Engagement in Futbol & Football
sessions.body: Just in time for the World Cup, join Amperity to learn how they are using unified customer data to help fans of futbol and football at the Seattle Sounders and the Baltimore Ravens have a better experience. At the Sounders, Amperity helped increase YoY season ticket deposits by 80% and create a fan experience outside the stadium as meaningful as watching a great match inside the stadium. At the Ravens, Amperity delivered value within the first week, unblocking two year stalled marketing goals and better fan engagement in 45 minutes.

sessions.title: Sponsored By: Amperity | How Five of the Largest Airlines Are Turning Customer Data Into a Competitive Edge
sessions.body: Airlines face real pressure right now — from rising fuel costs to shifting travel patterns. But the ones pulling ahead are the those making smarter use of their customer data. Amperity and Databricks are helping five of the largest airlines unify customer data across every touchpoint to build a complete picture of traveler preferences, reduce media spend, and deliver personalized experiences that drive loyalty. Join this session to hear how they did it and what you can apply to your own roadmap.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Anomalo | How GM Uses an Intelligent Data Analyst to Scale AI with Trusted Data
sessions.body: As General Motors transforms vehicles into software-defined, intelligent assistants, processing trillions of data points with absolute integrity is a safety and business imperative. To scale this vision, GM is migrating to the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform and operationalizing a large-scale data mesh architecture. With Databricks and Anomalo, GM embeds automated data quality into every domain, reducing centralized engineering burden and ensuring AI-ready data integrity across the organization.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Artefact | The workforce you won't recognise: Building the hybrid organization with AI Agents
sessions.body: Most AI strategies are stuck at the POC stage, not because the technology isn’t ready, but because the data foundation isn’t. In this session, we explore what high-performing organizations are actually building: hybrid workforces where AI agents and humans coordinate through a shared, governed data layer. We’ll show how leading organizations are structuring hybrid teams, why most agent deployments fail to reach production, and what it looks like when agents truly work alongside humans, not as assistants, but as part of the workforce, driving faster decisions, execution, and outcomes. We'll also hear directly from the field. Joining us is the CTO of Danone, who will share how one of the world's leading consumer goods companies is thinking about this shift. Join us to see a live multi-agent system in action and learn a practical blueprint for moving from isolated AI experiments to a production-grade hybrid workforce.

speakers.name: Ghadi Hobeika
speakers.bio:
Ghadi Hobeika is an experienced sales & marketing, data and e-commerce specialist with a strong background in digital media, growth hacking and analytics.
He is the Managing Partner & CEO, North America at Artefact, a global data-driven services company specialising in consulting for data transformation and digital & data marketing. Artefact is an independent global network with 36 offices in 27 countries, working with over 300 of major brands around the globe, such as Samsung, L'Oréal and Sanofi.

sessions.title: Sponsored By: Astronomer | Unifying Data and AI Orchestration with Apache Airflow
sessions.body: In a high-pressure kitchen, great service depends on mise en place — everything prepared, organized, and ready before the rush. Production AI demands the same discipline. This talk shows how Apache Airflow unifies data pipelines and AI workflows in one observable control plane and system of record — replacing fragmented observability, failure handling, and team handoffs. We'll walk through real projects covering multi-agent orchestration, AI-driven pipeline branching, and vision model integration — each illustrating a distinct production pattern and all running on Airflow. The best kitchens don't just execute recipes — they make the rush look effortless.

speakers.name: Kenten Danas
speakers.bio: Kenten leads the Developer Relations team at Astronomer and has a background in data engineering and data science. She has first-hand experience adopting and running Apache Airflow at large companies, and is passionate about helping other data engineers scale and get the most out of their data orchestration. When she isn't working with data she's typically outside trail running or skiing.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Astronomer | Your AI Strategy Has a Context Problem. Orchestration Solves It.
sessions.body: Every enterprise has an AI strategy. Few have the foundation to deliver on it. Most treat context as something defined upfront and consumed downstream. Semantic layers define metrics. Ontologies model relationships. Neither captures what actually ran. Enterprise context is not static. It is evidence that accumulates continuously: which pipelines ran, what changed upstream, what humans corrected. Orchestration is the only layer where that evidence accumulates naturally, not as declared truth, but as a continuous record of what actually happened. That is what production AI runs on. This talk outlines the architectural pattern that makes it possible.

speakers.name: Carter Page
speakers.bio: Carter Page is the EVP of R&D at Astronomer, the home of the modern data orchestration platform. A 30-year veteran of enterprise data infrastructure, Carter previously led data engineering at Two Sigma, overseeing the firm's mission-critical global data pipelines. Prior to Two Sigma, Carter spent a decade at Google, where he led the development of many of the early products and technologies of GCP, including Cloud Bigtable.

sessions.title: Sponsored By: Atlan | Mastercard's "Context by Design": Engineering AI-Ready Data Products at Scale
sessions.body: At Mastercard, trust has always been the product. For six years, that trust has been engineered in layers: privacy by design, then data by design, and now context by design — each evolution built on the last. Now, as AI agents begin transacting at the speed of commerce, the latest layer matters most — an Enterprise Context Layer, built on Databricks, that machines can read, reason over, and act on without human intervention at every step. Join Fabien Thiaucourt and Vivek Radhakrishnan of Mastercard, and Austin Kronz of Atlan, to learn how engineering and enablement co-own context as a dual mission — and why the productive tension between them is the reason governance actually sticks — how automated metadata and human-centered product thinking combine to build AI-ready data products on Databricks, and how this foundation sets the stage for text-to-SQL and conversational search — and every AI use case that follows.

speakers.name: Austin Kronz
speakers.job_title: Director of Data and AI Strategy
speakers.bio: Austin focuses on enabling humans of data to do more, together. This includes helping customers understand and implement modern data concepts like Data Mesh or DataOps and evangelizing the active metadata category. Austin spent the last 5 years at Gartner as a Director Analyst in their Data and Analytics group.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Atlan | The Enterprise Context Layer: Why Agents Fail — and the Fix — Demystified and Demoed
sessions.body: Everyone's talking about context layers. Nobody agrees on what one is — a semantic layer with a better name? A knowledge graph in a trench coat? AI is moving from pilot to production — and it made data teams into janitors: cleaning up hallucinations, debugging agents. But the context agents need most is what data teams already own. The definitions, the lineage, the institutional knowledge. That's not a cost center. It's your most strategic AI asset. You already have Databricks — maybe Unity Catalog too. But your agents still don't know which "revenue" definition to use, which tables to trust, or what the business actually means. The gap between pilot and production isn't a model problem. It's a context problem. Join Prukalpa Sankar and Varun Banka to see it live: dark Databricks tables become AI-ready — automated lineage mapped, AI-bootstrapped definitions added, Context Quality Score green — and a Genie query returns a governed response via MCP. All live. All on stage.

speakers.name: Prukalpa Sankar
speakers.bio: Prukalpa Sankar is the co-founder of Atlan, a modern collaborative data workspace. She has previously co-founded a leading data for good company where she led data teams for organizations like the UN, the World Bank, and several large governments.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: AWS | Breaking Data Silos with Multi-Engine Catalog Federation
sessions.body: Mastercard moved beyond the "Multi-Catalog" struggle and successfully federated Databricks Unity Catalog to AWS Glue. This allows Apache Spark engines to consume data in Apache Iceberg tables that register in Databricks Unity Catalog and sync seamlessly across AWS services like Amazon EMR, enabling ACID reliability and multi-engine interoperability without vendor lock-in. Mastercard achieved a Single Source of Truth for governance allowing engineers to use the best engine for the job without metadata fragmentation. Mastercard achieved seamless catalog federation, allowing domain teams to choose optimal compute engines. This open-format strategy created a sustainable, future-proof architecture supporting machine learning, streaming, and governed data sharing across the enterprise.

speakers.name: Ranju Kumari
speakers.bio: Driving Mastercard’s next-generation engineering and data platform evolution by building scalable platforms, modern architectures, and interoperable solutions. Focused on Apache Iceberg-based lakehouse architecture, seamless hybrid integration, and engineering resilient platforms that support large-scale batch and near-real-time data processing.

speakers.name: Sabha Parameswaran
speakers.bio: Principal Solutions Architect managing Databricks Platform for data analytics and artificial intelligence (AI) on Amazon Web Services (AWS), with 25+ years of experience delivering large-scale solutions across cloud and on-premises environments. Expertise includes generative AI (GenAI) implementation and strategy, cloud-native application development, serverless architecture design, and modernization initiatives.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Boomi | Action Is the New Insight: Agentic Workflows in Practice
sessions.body: The CDO is now the CDAIO. But while the hype focuses on agentic analytics, real value lies in action. Using the latest research from industry professionals, we’ll reveal how top leaders are moving beyond insights to agentic workflows. We’ll break down the essentials—golden data, governance, and security—needed to successfully activate AI. Don't just watch the AI revolution; lead it. Join us to learn how to bridge the gap between data and execution and get started today.

speakers.name: Travis Price
speakers.bio:
Travis Price is the Vice President of Global Field Engineering at Boomi, where his team was built with one purpose: helping customers navigate the complexity of their data and application environments so they can deliver real business value and build the trusted data foundation that powers agentic AI.
His perspective on enterprise data carries real weight because he has operated at every layer of the problem. He knows what it looks like from the platform side at IBM and SAP, from the application side at Workday, and from the cloud and AI strategy side after six years leading the Global Data and AI Strategy practice at Amazon Web Services. His career journey has given Travis a view of enterprise data transformation that is simultaneously technical, commercial, and organizationally grounded, earned from working the problem at every level of the stack and every stage of the customer journey.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Capgemini | The Foundations for a Million Agents
sessions.body: Every organization can build an agent — almost nobody is ready to manage a million of them. This session lays out what it actually takes, starting with AI Persona definition: how the business delegates to an agent as a team member, not a system. It then breaks apart four disciplines that must scale independently. Integration & Ecosystem spans MCP, Unity Catalog, and the governance of AI through MLflow, grounding agents in trusted data and policy. Development and Discovery use Genie and Databricks Marketplace to build and evolve agents. Business Management, through Mosaic AI and MLflow, drives accountability. AI Resource Management makes IT the HR function for the AI workforce. Underpinning it all is why a streaming Delta Lake architecture is central to an AI future. This is the architecture for a million agents.

speakers.name: Steve Jones
speakers.bio: Steve Jones is a published author on topics from Cloud and SOA to AI Ethics and Generative AI, and in journals from IEEE Software to the Financial Times. He has been Capgemini’s global lead for Java, where he was a member of several JCP groups including JavaSE 6. He also led the initial group efforts on Cloud and SaaS, and established Capgemini’s global businesses in MDM and Big Data.  Steve has built some of the largest next-generation data platforms, and his architectural approaches, such as the Business Data Lake, have become standards with organizations such as Open Group.  Most recently, he has been focusing on the challenge of the 50% AI business and the organization and technical changes required to achieve this.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Capital One | Secure Data Collaboration: A Modern Enterprise Enclave Architecture
sessions.body: Collaborating on sensitive data is critical for business insights but creates significant security and compliance risks. This session introduces a secure data enclave architecture that enables cross-functional analysis on sensitive enterprise data (like PII or IP). Learn how this model strengthens data privacy and provides a comprehensive, auditable trail without moving raw data.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Capital One Software | Utilizing Context and AI for Cost Optimization & Security
sessions.body: Managing data systems at scale often leads to hidden inefficiencies and risks that can impact business performance. Capital One will share research on how to leverage context-aware AI to drive significant cost savings compared to manual optimization and strengthen data security posture of large-scale systems. Attendees will gain actionable insights into the role and impact of context on data cloud optimization and security.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Capital One Software |Trust at AI Speed: Governance and Security for the Enterprise
sessions.body: Despite high AI adoption, few enterprises see meaningful impact because traditional governance and security methods slow innovation. For most organizations, governance lives outside the platform, in workflows that operate at human speed. To bridge the gap between investment and impact, enterprises must embed governance and protection into the data platform. In this session we will discuss: - Governing and protecting what AI models learn from, so sensitive data can fuel training without surfacing in outputs. - Lineage, accountability, and protection when AI agents act on enterprise data - Keeping governance and protection consistent as data moves across clouds - Unstructured data as the new risk surface

speakers.name: Rex Washburn
speakers.bio: I help organizations make data strategy actually work—and I help leaders and teams rethink what's possible. As a practice leader and advisor, I operate at the intersection of data strategy, architecture, and team development. I'm passionate about sharing what I've learned through speaking, writing, and partnering with data leaders and teams navigating complex data transformations.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: CDW | Ask Your Data Anything — The Day Trust Flatlined
sessions.body: You deployed Genie. The demo worked. Ninety days later, adoption is flat and nobody can explain why. CDW's Head of Presales and Chief Architect break down the gap between Genie deployment and Genie adoption — and the four MVDG conditions (Ownership, Definitions, Lineage, Guardrails) that close it.

speakers.name: Christopher Marcolis
speakers.bio:
Christopher Marcolis is Head of Presales for CDW's Data & Analytics professional services practice and a member of the practice leadership team. He shapes CDW's go-to-market strategy, partner ecosystem, and customer engagement model across the modern data stack — with deep collaboration on Databricks.

Christopher and his team, partners with customers to scope engagements that span data strategy, platform modernization, governance, and AI, keeping every conversation anchored in business outcomes rather than tools.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: CEI | The Agentic Enterprise: How AI Engineering Is Rewiring Business Models
sessions.body: Most enterprises are adopting AI, yet few are realizing meaningful transformation because they remain stuck thinking in terms of models and isolated use cases. In this session, Sunil Senan introduces the Agentic Enterprise, a new way to understand how AI is fundamentally reshaping how organizations operate and create value. He offers a reality check on why today’s AI approaches fall short, then outlines the shift from models to systems, from systems to enterprises, and ultimately to new business models. Attendees will explore how AI engineering enables autonomous, adaptive operations and how business transformation emerges when AI execution is tightly linked to real-world outcomes. The session concludes with real patterns, lessons learned, and a clear call to action for leaders ready to move from experimentation to enterprise‑wide impact.

speakers.name: Sunil Senan
speakers.bio: Sunil Senan is Global CEO of CEI and an industry leader in data and AI‑led enterprise transformation. Throughout his leadership career, Sunil has guided organizations through large‑scale transformation initiatives that move data and AI from experimentation into core business operations. He is known for driving enterprise‑wide AI adoption, aligning advanced analytics and AI systems to business models, and linking technology investments to measurable business outcomes. Sunil regularly advises executive teams on how AI engineering enables autonomous, adaptive enterprises and is a sought‑after voice on the evolution from AI systems to new business models.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Coalesce | The Age of Data Exhaustion
sessions.body: No one talks about it, but data teams are tired. They're tired of managing thousands of tables, brittle transformation logic and AI pilots built on foundations no one fully trusts. The problem isn’t data volume. It’s overload. Code overload demands disciplined transformation. Data overload demands intelligent cataloging. And chaos erodes trust. In this session, we’ll show how modern data teams restore order with a metadata-driven data operating layer that standardizes transformation, connects governance to build-time and makes data quality proactive instead of reactive. Because AI doesn’t fix disorder, it amplifies it.

speakers.name: Douglas Barrett
speakers.bio:
Douglas brings over 30 years of experience delivering data-driven solutions for large organizations worldwide. Beginning his career in London, he has worked across industries including banking, airlines, retail, and gaming across the UK, Europe, Australia, New Zealand, and the United States.

He focuses on helping organizations modernize their data platforms using technologies like Databricks to unify data, analytics, and AI. Douglas advocates for strong business engagement and rapid, iterative delivery, using modern data and AI software to align business needs with data realities—enabling scalable, maintainable solutions that can endure for years.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Cognizant | An AI Data Foundation for Decision Intelligence for Medtronic, in Partnership with Cognizant
sessions.body: We established a robust Digital Data Foundation to enable more informed, data-driven decision-making across the enterprise. Our approach emphasized the development of both foundational and analytical data products, supported by advanced AI and business intelligence capabilities to deliver deeper analytics and intuitive insights. Conversational BI enhanced accessibility and adoption across the organization, while AI agents driven automation streamlined data engineering processes and significantly improved data quality and enabled multiple business LOBs processes with the right data and analytics. Databricks serves as the unified platform for data engineering and AI/ML workloads, with Unity Data Catalog delivering a comprehensive, integrated view to enable efficient data governance and discovery.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Cognizant | The Autonomous Data Value Chain: How Agent Bricks is Redefining Data Engineering on Databricks
sessions.body: Most data teams have modernized to the lakehouse — but the data value chain is still manual, fragmented and slow. Engineers jump between discovery, modeling, pipelines, quality checks, governance and ops, stitching together tools and workflows that don’t scale with AI. This lightning session shows what comes next. You’ll see how Agent Bricks act as the production‑grade foundation for building intelligent, cost‑aware agents on Databricks — and how Data Value Chain Agents turn the end‑to‑end lifecycle into a coordinated, autonomous system. Using Cognizant’s Agentic AI–driven Data Value Chain, we’ll walk through how domain‑specific agents for discovery, modeling, engineering, quality, governance and operations collaborate through orchestration — not handoffs. This is not a theoretical future. You’ll learn how teams are moving from pipelines to agent‑orchestrated workflows, where engineers shift from writing glue code to directing intelligent agents that continuously optimize.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Confluent | How Grainger Powers Real-time Supplier Compliance with Confluent and Databricks
sessions.body: Modern procurement demands more than periodic reviews — it requires a continuous, intelligent pulse on every supplier relationship. In this session, Grainger shares how they moved from batch pipelines and manual scorecarding to a real-time supplier compliance platform built on Confluent and Databricks. You'll learn how Confluent's Tableflow seamlessly bridges streaming Kafka data into Delta tables within Databricks Unity Catalog — eliminating brittle ETL, unifying schemas, and giving Procurement teams the live insights they need to make faster, more confident decisions about their supplier portfolio.

speakers.name: PRADEEP NAGISETTY
speakers.bio: Pradeep is a Sr. Engineering Manager at Grainger where he drives scalable event-driven architecture, API strategy, and developer experience across cloud-native platforms.

speakers.name: Paul Cappelluzzo
speakers.bio: Paul is the Principal Data Architect at Grainger, where he focuses on bringing order and insight to complex data environments through enterprise strategy, architecture, innovation, collaboration, and governance.

sessions.title: Sponsored By: Confluent | Simplify AI-Ready Tables with Confluent Tableflow, Databricks, and Unity Catalog
sessions.body: Learn how Confluent and Databricks are simplifying the path from real-time data to governed, analytics- and AI-ready tables. This session will show how Confluent Tableflow automatically materializes Kafka topics into Delta tables and registers them with Unity Catalog — eliminating the need for custom streaming pipelines. We’ll walk through how this integration helps data engineers reduce ingestion complexity, enforce data governance, and make real-time data immediately usable for analytics and AI.

speakers.name: Kasun Indrasiri Gamage
speakers.bio: Kasun is a Senior Product Manager at Confluent, driving innovation in the Tableflow product. He possesses a strong background in data streaming and application integration, and previously led product management for Azure Event Hubs at Microsoft. He is the author of gRPC: Up and Running and Microservices for the Enterprise, and has shared his insights at conferences such as Current, KubeCon, Databricks Data and AI summit and GOTO.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Crogl | Building AI for Enterprise Security. A neuro-symbolic approach
sessions.body: AI consumerization is inspiring startups and enterprise teams to build AI agents for security. But as much as 95% of Enterprise AI projects are failing. Challenges come from over reliance on a single technology e.g. LLMs, data fragmentation, organizational process nuances and governance concerns. Working with complex orgs like US DOW and Fortune 500, we have developed a neuro-symbolic approach to building the AI for Enterprise Security. This session deep dives into our approach. We will share the architecture, the specific agent, knowledge graph, and relational components. You will leave with concrete patterns for designing resilient, model-agnostic security capability on top of your existing data infrastructure. Attendees will get an opportunity to sign up for the preview release of the free AI for Enterprise Security from Crogl.

sessions.title: Sponsored By: Datadog | 4,500 Jobs, No Blind Spots: AccuWeather's Serverless Databricks Migration with Datadog
sessions.body: AccuWeather delivers forecasts to 1.5 billion people daily. When their pipelines fail, severe weather warnings don't reach the people who need them. The team used to wait 90 minutes before responding to any alert — not because fixes were hard, but because monitoring that fires on every transient failure trains teams to ignore everything. This session shows how AccuWeather migrated to Serverless Databricks Workflows and operated approximately 4,500 weekly Lakeflow jobs with Datadog Data Observability. We’ll cover how AccuWeather using serverless cut compute costs in half, and the pre-flight pattern that catches failures before expensive cluster jobs run. Additionally, Datadog turns Databricks system table data into alerts built around weather-specific logic, leading to over 50% fewer unactionable alerts and 80% faster incident response — this is due to firing incidents only after five failures in a 45-minute window, and only when multiple forecast models fail in the same critical hour.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Datadog | Experimentation & Product Analytics in the Agentic World: Bringing User Signals to Every Release
sessions.body: When developing software with autonomous agents, the bottleneck shifts from writing code to evaluating it. Agents can generate changes continuously. What limits progress is how quickly you can tell whether those changes are acceptable. Agentic development looks less like traditional software engineering and more like reinforcement learning: a loop of build, release, evaluate, where the fastest signals dominate. If your unit tests return in seconds and your conversion data takes two weeks, guess which one shapes the product. Teams need fast proxies for signals that arrive too slowly to influence an agent's build loop, and governance is needed to reason about signal quality, noise, and coverage. This session introduces an evaluation infrastructure that orchestrates synthetic tests, production telemetry, analytics, and controlled releases to gate autonomous changes. Datadog is building toward this layer, but the framework applies to any team rethinking infrastructure for an agentic world.

speakers.name: Che Sharma
speakers.bio: Che Sharma is a Director of Product Management at Datadog, which he joined following Datadog's acquisition of Eppo (where he was founder and CEO). After pivotal roles as the 4th data scientist at Airbnb and an early data scientist at Webflow, Che founded Eppo to offer the first commercial experimentation platform to rival tools built in-house at the world's biggest tech companies. Now leading Datadog's newly-built Experiments, Feature Flags, and Product Analytics products, Che is again focused on helping product and data teams drive growth, make smart decisions, and build influence as key leaders of the emerging AI era.

sessions.title:
Sponsored By: DataHub | Agents That Get It Right: Grounding Databricks Genie in Enterprise
Metadata
sessions.body: Answering business questions with AI agents sounds simple — until your agent queries the wrong table, misunderstands what "revenue" means in your organization, or returns a number no one can trace back to a source. The missing ingredient isn't a better model; it's context.In this talk, we'll show how teams are combining Databricks Genie with DataHub, the leading open-source metadata management platform, to build conversational analytics agents that actually work in production. By grounding Genie in DataHub's governed metadata — glossary terms, column-level lineage, dataset ownership, and business context — agents canroute queries correctly, return trusted answers, and cite the data asset behind every response. We'll walk through the architecture, share concrete patterns for connecting Genie to your enterprise metadata layer, and show how teams can validate agent reliability before rolling these out beyond the data team. Attendees will leave with a practical blueprint for turningtheir Databricks investment into an agent that any business user can trust.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Dataiku | Dataiku + Databricks: Your Stack for Production-Ready AI Agents
sessions.body: In this session, discover how Dataiku extends the Databricks lakehouse to accelerate AI and agent development, orchestration, and governance. We will explore how teams can rapidly build AI and GenAI applications using visual, collaborative workflows; create and orchestrate intelligent agents leveraging Databricks capabilities like Vector Search and Genie; and ensure enterprise-grade governance with built-in lifecycle management, monitoring, and controls. Learn how organizations are moving from experimentation to production faster by combining Databricks’ powerful data platform with Dataiku’s unified AI layer, enabling seamless collaboration across data, engineering, and business teams to deliver real-world AI at scale.

speakers.name: Dmitri Ryssev
speakers.bio: Dmitri Ryssev is a Staff Solutions Architect at Dataiku, where he leads technical engagement on the Dataiku–Databricks partnership. He works with joint customers to design integrated architectures across both platforms, enabling data teams to build, deploy, and govern machine learning and generative AI workloads at scale. With nearly a decade of experience in customer-facing roles across the data and analytics ecosystem, he brings a practical perspective on moving AI initiatives from concept to production impact.

sessions.title: Sponsored By: dbt Labs | dbt and Databricks Partner Well-Architected Framework for AI Apps
sessions.body: Building AI apps on Databricks is straightforward — building AI apps that are trusted, governed, and production-ready is a different challenge entirely. In this talk, we walk through the Databricks Partner Well-Architected Framework with dbt Labs as the data foundation. We’ll show how structured, tested, and semantically-rich data flows from dbt into Unity Catalog, and from Unity Catalog into any AI application running on Databricks. We'll deploy a live-managed app on Databricks that pulls governed assets directly from Unity Catalog with lineage, contracts, and semantic definitions built end-to-end in dbt. The result is an architectural blueprint where your AI apps aren't guessing at the data beneath them — with dbt, they have the required context to be governed, reliable, and right. You’ll leave with a Well-Architected reference pattern for AI apps on Databricks, and a clear picture of how dbt and Unity Catalog become the governed data infrastructure every AI use case depends on.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: dbt Labs | Your BI Copilot Is Blind - Crafting an Agent That Goes Beyond the Dashboard
sessions.body:
BI copilots can answer questions about what's on screen: filters, dimensions, chart values. But ask "why is this number wrong?" or "where does this column come from?" and they hit a wall. They can't see past the dashboard.

 

Integral Ad Science built an AI agent that goes deeper. Directly within the BI layer, it connects to your dbt project through MCP and validates findings in Databricks SQL (Unity Catalog) via the Databricks SQL MCP server. The agent extracts context from the report, reads compiled SQL, traces column-level lineage from mart to source, explains the business logic in each transformation, and confirms what the data shows in the warehouse.

 

For analysts, it eliminates hours spent following DAGs and reading model code. For business users, a persona switch delivers clear, natural language answers. Mars Dauer will show how MCP makes this possible across dbt and Databricks and share an end-to-end investigation, from BI report to root cause to Jira ticket, all in one chat.

speakers.name: Mars Dauer
speakers.bio: Mars is a Senior Director of Enterprise Data & AI at Integral Ad Science, where he leads enterprise data platform strategy and delivery across analytics, governance, and applied AI. He builds scalable, trusted data products and modernizes legacy environments into cloud-native architectures-improving reliability, cost, and decision speed-while bridging executives and engineering teams to improve how the business uses data, automation, and AI.

sessions.title: Sponsored By: definity | From Observability to Agentic Data Engineering: What It Actually Takes
sessions.body: Data observability is now standard in lakehouse platforms, but it stops at reactive monitoring. As teams push toward proactive agentic workflows, LLMs alone aren’t enough. Without production-aware context, ability to take action in-flight, and automated guardrails, AI remains limited to suggestive copilots trained on generic data. This session breaks down what it takes to build agentic capabilities to continuously optimize cost, resolve incidents in-motion, and evolve pipeline code. We’ll show how definity enables them through full-stack context across data, pipelines, and infrastructure; runtime execution control; and built-in validation loops — turning signals into autonomous action inside Spark pipelines.

speakers.name: Roy Daniel
speakers.bio:
Roy is the CEO and co-founder of definity, the Agentic Data Engineering platform for the Lakehouse and Spark ecosystem, helping enterprise teams optimize cost, improve reliability, and accelerate developer velocity.
Prior, Roy held data and product leadership positions across Fortune 500 companies, most recently at FIS/Worldpay.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Deloitte | Databricks for Banking ML: Accelerating Delivery with an AI-Enabled Platform
sessions.body: M&T Bank, a leading U.S. financial services institution, has launched an initiative to establish a well-governed data science workbench on Databricks, forming the foundation for its next-gen data science and ML platform within the bank. The program is centered on: (1) building the core platform capabilities and migrating key Treasury & Financial models to Databricks, (2) accelerating innovation by using AI, enabling faster model development and streamlined deployment, (3) standing up a well-governed framework to manage the end-to-end model lifecycle and MLOps processes, and (4) future-proofing the organization with Databricks ML The overarching goal is to setup next-gen ML across the bank—supporting priority regulatory and growth use cases while supporting transition from legacy ML platform. Deloitte is M&T’s strategic implementation partner, leveraging its Brickbuilder agentic AI–enabled asset, “Data Assist,” to reverse engineer legacy platform and forward engineer into Databricks.

speakers.name: Italiano Fabio
speakers.job_title: SVP, Head of Data Tooling and BI

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Deloitte | Driving Enterprise Transformation with Agentic AI
sessions.body: In the era of enterprise AI, competitive advantage depends on more than deploying smarter models—it requires a dedicated, data-informed path to scale. Join Deloitte’s China Widener for a discussion on how organizations can move from fragmented AI experimentation to enterprise-wide transformation. This session will explore how leaders can connect AI investments to trusted data, future-state workflows and measurable ROI. Learn how forward-thinking leaders are prioritizing the right AI and agentic use cases, building confidence in what to scale, and turning AI investments into sustained business impact.

speakers.name: China Widener
speakers.job_title: Vice Chair and US TMT Industry Leader
speakers.bio:
China is Deloitte’s vice chair and US Technology, Media & Telecommunications (TMT) industry leader. She also serves on Deloitte's US Board of Directors.

She offers a distinctive perspective on the future of the TMT industry, with a particular interest in the evolution of Agentic AI—intelligent systems capable of autonomous decision-making—and their transformative impact across the enterprise. She is passionate about helping clients unlock the full potential of Agentic AI to accelerate innovation, improve operational efficiency, and create new sources of competitive advantage, all while maintaining a steadfast commitment to trustworthy AI.

China has co-authored articles on AI, technology frameworks for enterprises, delivery model analysis, and closing the talent gap. She is a highly sought-after speaker and facilitator and her technology experience and career progression has been featured on several podcasts and publications.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Deloitte | Future-Proofing Finance: Modernizing Banking Data Platforms
sessions.body: As financial institutions race to modernize their data infrastructure amid rising expectations for real-time insights, data lineage, and AI-ready systems, Navy Federal Credit Union (NFCU) sought to unify multiple data sources and strengthen governance to improve scalability, security, and regulatory confidence. Deloitte collaborated with NFCU to design and deliver an integrated data platform leveraging Databricks Lakehouse, establishing standardized ingestion and transformation patterns, lineage-enabled governance with Unity Catalog, and secure access controls to support enterprise reporting and advanced analytics. The team has enhanced data engineering delivery using Databricks Assistant and is reimagining Finance processes embedded with multi-agent solutions powered by Agent Bricks. Together, we enabled a scalable foundation that accelerates insight delivery while improving transparency, auditability, and confidence in data used for future Finance and AI use cases.

speakers.name: Jonathan Weil
speakers.bio: Jon advises banking leaders on strategic initiatives to modernize technology and operations using data and AI-augmented solutions. He brings expertise in program delivery complemented by technology implementation experience and robust functional knowledge of bank processes and operations. He also has a passion for activating program outcomes to drive value through change management and adoption, having led multiple efforts to engage, educate, and empower team members across lines of business and functions.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Deloitte | Generating Realistic, High-Fidelity Synthetic Financial Data on Databricks
sessions.body: Access to customer financial data is often slowed by privacy regulations, hindering innovation in risk management and personalization. Deloitte’s dual-model solution on the Databricks Platform generates high-fidelity synthetic data to overcome this challenge. It combines generative adversarial networks for structured data (demographics, creditworthiness) and LLMs for behavioral insights (price sensitivity), complete with an AI-automated quality review. This provides a safe foundation for developing models, testing risk algorithms, and simulating market strategies. This session demonstrates how this approach accelerates financial innovation while reducing compliance risk by replicating customer data utility without exposing sensitive information.

speakers.name: Hemanth Yarlagadda
speakers.job_title: Lead AI and Data Science Engineer II
speakers.bio: Hemanth Yarlagadda is a Lead AI and Data Science Engineer with 13+ years of experience turning complex business problems into scalable, production-grade AI/ML solutions. He has consistently delivered measurable impact across fraud detection, financial risk, market surveillance, healthcare, and e-commerce, building intelligent systems that reduce operational losses, automate critical workflows, and drive data-driven decision making at enterprise scale. He is deeply passionate about engineering end-to-end ML and big data solutions that create real-world business value.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Domo | Eliminating the Warehouse “Tail Problem”: AI-Powered Optimization on Databricks + Domo
sessions.body: Warehouse operations don’t fail at the start of the day—they fail at the end. As real-world conditions diverge from static planning assumptions, bottlenecks emerge across palletizer lanes, creating a costly “tail problem” that requires constant manual intervention. This session explores how one logistics operator reimagined warehouse automation by combining Databricks and Domo to create a self-adaptive system. As palletizers fall behind, go offline, or deviate from expected performance, the platform continuously analyzes live data from Databricks and recommends exactly what actions to take—what to move, where to move it, and why. Through an interactive Domo application, supervisors can execute AI-driven recommendations, simulate changes, and respond instantly to disruptions with automated evacuation workflows. The result: a self-aware, adaptive system that replaces reactive firefighting with proactive optimization—improving efficiency, reducing downtime, and delivering measurable ROI.

sessions.title: Sponsored By: Domo | From 20 Hours to Two — Databricks and Domo: Billion-Row Insights, Delivered to Every Customer
sessions.body: What if you could transform multi-day analytics cycles into near real-time iteration — without sacrificing scale or sophistication? We explore how combining Databricks serverless SQL warehouses with Domo Cloud Amplifier unlocks unprecedented speed on billion-row datasets — cutting cycles from 20+ hours to just 1–2. But speed is only half the story — with Domo Publish, you can deploy curated, governed content to dedicated child Domo instances, giving your customers their own fully interactive analytics environment to explore, update, and build on. Paired with Domo Everywhere, you can scale governed, read/write data products across your entire customer base — all managed from a single parent instance. Finally, we'll showcase how Domo AI and MCP accelerate MVP development, turning complex data into high-impact insights faster than ever. If you're looking to operationalize analytics, deliver data products your customers truly own, and respond to change at speed, this session is your blueprint.

speakers.name: Daniel Gouveia
speakers.bio:
Dan Gouveia is a Principal Solution Consultant at Domo with over 20 years of experience helping organizations turn data and technology into a competitive advantage. A customer-facing advisor at the intersection of business and technology, Dan specializes in solving complex business challenges through scalable data and analytics solutions.

He partners with some of Domo’s largest enterprise customers, working across the organization—from marketing and sales to finance and HR—to transform fragmented data into actionable insights. Known for his ability to translate business needs into technical execution, Dan helps companies modernize their analytics ecosystems and drive faster, smarter decision-making.

speakers.name: Max Isley
speakers.bio: Max Isley is Director of Business Intelligence & Analytics at Live Nation Entertainment, where he leads analytics strategy and AI-powered data solutions for one of the world's largest live entertainment companies. With over 10 years in the industry, Max has built production AI systems that integrate Databricks to drive sponsorship and business decisions at scale. He specializes in translating complex data infrastructure into actionable intelligence for commercial teams.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Domo | From Prediction to Action: Agentic AI for Ambulatory Care on Databricks
sessions.body: Healthcare organizations don’t suffer from a lack of data—they suffer from a lack of timely action. No-shows, late arrivals, and provider delays create millions in lost revenue and poor patient experiences, yet most systems stop at reporting the problem. In this session, we demonstrate how Databricks powers real-time predictive intelligence, while Domo operationalizes it through agentic AI workflows that take action. Using live appointment, patient, weather, and traffic data, AI agents continuously evaluate no-show risk and dynamically decide the next best action—triggering SMS outreach, recommending overbooking strategies, and alerting staff before disruptions occur. Attendees will see how this closed-loop system transforms static analytics into autonomous decisioning, with full governance, auditability, and human-in-the-loop validation. The result is a proactive care model that reduces no-shows, stabilizes clinic throughput, and delivers measurable ROI within weeks—not months.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: EPAM | Enabling granular decision-making with advanced analytics and AI
sessions.body: MercedesBenz & EPAM partnered with Databricks to reinvent how data & AI drive data driven decisions. We replaced a fragmented, legacy stack with a unified lakehouse platform built on medallion & delta live capabilities, built to scale innovation across the enterprise. On top of this MBUSA’s solution transforms decision making delivering the right offer, to the right customer, at the right time and place in one of the world’s most competitive premium auto markets. By unifying internal & external data through a proprietary cross make taxonomy, the platform becomes a true single source of truth. Advanced analytics go beyond dashboards: root cause insights, MLbased price elasticity, & a natural language AI assistant (Genie) put data & AI directly in the hands of the business. The result: faster decisions, smarter actions, & measurable business impact at scale. Impact: One trusted competitive view | Actionable, role based insights for hundreds of users | From data chaos to valuable insights

speakers.name: Anil Gadam
speakers.job_title: Data & AI Leader - Mercedes Benz USA
speakers.bio:
Anil Gadam is a global leader with 24+ years at Mercedes-Benz, driving large-scale digital and data transformation across the U.S., China, India, and Germany. At Mercedes-Benz USA, he leads the shift from legacy systems to a cloud-native Databricks Lakehouse on Azure, spanning data strategy, architecture, data products, semantic modeling, reporting, and governance. He is passionate about turning data into business value and advancing AI/ML adoption across Sales, Marketing, and Aftersales to enhance insights, customer experience, and innovation.
As a speaker, Anil brings a practitioner’s perspective on building modern data platforms, operationalizing AI, and leading transformation in complex global environments

speakers.name: Giuseppe Conserva
speakers.bio:
Giuseppe Conserva is a data and AI leader with more than a decade of experience transforming the automotive business through advanced analytics and digital innovation.
At Mercedes Benz USA, he leads a strategic modernization of data and AI capabilities, unlocking new ways to scale insight driven decisions across the organization. As Manager for Top End Vehicles, he combines data, product strategy, and market intelligence to accelerate growth and elevate performance.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: EXL | From Dilemma to Decision-Ready: Turning Data into Actionable Intelligence
sessions.body: Enterprises face a growing chasm between raw data and actionable insights. Fragmented lineage, inconsistent quality, disconnected governance, and unstructured data complexities undermine trust in analytics and impede informed decision-making. This session explores how EXLdata.ai bridges this gap by embedding an agentic, semantic intelligence layer directly into Databricks technologies like Delta Lake and Unity Catalog. This integrated approach overcomes obstacles to transform raw data into reliable, context-rich intelligence at scale. Attendees will learn how to: • Reconstruct data lineage to ensure traceability from source to insight • Automate data ingestion & transformation using coordinated, multi-agent workflows • Integrate technical & business metadata for transparent, business-aware governance • Shift data quality control to continuous, proactive anomaly detection • Activate unstructured data through embedded ML and semantic enrichment

sessions.title: Sponsored by: EY | AI Innovation in Action: Driving Business Transformation with Data & AI
sessions.body: As data and AI continue to reshape how organizations operate, innovate, and compete, diverse leadership has become a critical driver of success. This panel brings together senior women leaders from EY, Databricks, and a client organization to explore how women are actively shaping the future of data, analytics, and AI at scale. Moving beyond inspiration to practical insight, the discussion will highlight real-world lessons from designing modern data platforms, deploying AI responsibly, building data-driven cultures, and translating emerging technologies into measurable business value. Panelists will share perspectives on what it takes to lead complex data and AI initiatives in today’s rapidly evolving environment—and how strong ecosystem partnerships accelerate impact.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: EY | The Future of Finance Is Now
sessions.body:
Finance is at a turning point: fragmented data and manual processes areout, and forward-thinking leaders are embracing transformation. This session revealshow today’s CFOs are leveraging Databricks Data and AI services to revolutionizefinance functions, FP&A, Controllership, Supply Chain, Risk, and Tax, by buildingtrusted, governed, and scalable data foundations.

 

Attendees will learn how to move from process-centric to data-centric models with afocus on people, process, and technology, including the launch of a scaled FinanceData Office and unified data platform. Explore how EY’s Finance Data Intelligence,powered by Databricks, drives automated data ingestion, improved data quality, and asingle source of truth. Discover how these innovations reduce risk and enable faster,smarter decision-making for modern finance teams.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: F5 | Who’s Controlling Your Agents?
sessions.body:
You’ve built and deployed your agents, but once they’re live, how do you ensure they stay within bounds?   Agents don’t fail loudly. Poisoned vector data, prompt injection, or dangerous tool calls aren’t flagged, they’re executed. That can lead to data leakage, unauthorized actions, and silent drift outside intended boundaries.   In this session, F5 shows how to enforce runtime guardrails that give full visibility into agent behavior, tool usage, and decision paths, so teams can secure agents without breaking workflows.  

 

Key Takeaways

  • Enforce boundaries on agent behavior, tool use, and data access at runtime
  • Gain visibility into agent actions across multi-step workflows
  • Use red teaming to uncover vulnerabilities before production and auto remediate

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Fireworks AI | Own Your AI: Beat Frontier Models With Your Own Data - Presented by Fireworks AI
sessions.body: The best AI companies aren't renting intelligence from closed model APIs—they're building their own. In this session, Roberto from Fireworks AI busts three common myths about training open models: that closed models are always better, that training is hard, and that you need massive labeled datasets. Drawing on real production examples from real-world examples from clients, he'll show how supervised training, direct preference optimization, and reinforcement training turn your production data into a compounding moat—and why the best model for your product is the one you own.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Fivetran | Building an AI-Ready Data Foundation at Superhuman with Databricks and Fivetran
sessions.body: As Superhuman expanded its AI platform across Grammarly, Coda, Superhuman Mail and Superhuman Go, more of the business began to rely on timely data from Salesforce, Outreach, Pardot, Stripe, Zendesk, Qualtrics and other third-party systems. The challenge went far beyond moving data into Databricks. Go-to-market, finance and customer teams needed faster, reliable access to trusted data without turning every new data request into weeks of custom engineering. In this session, Superhuman shares how it standardized third-party ingestion on Fivetran, built a self-serve operating model in Databricks and used Connector SDK plus AI-assisted development to cut specialized connector work from months to days. The result: faster reporting and alerting for a $300M ad program, support for internal AI-ready workflows and a broader data foundation that contributed to a 10% lift in LTV.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Fivetran | From Backlog to Breakthrough: Inova Scales Data and AI with Fivetran and Databricks
sessions.body: Healthcare organizations operate some of the most complex data environments, spanning thousands of systems across clinical, financial and operational domains. At Inova Health, this complexity created an opportunity to rethink how data could better support analytics and AI at scale. In this session, Inova shares how they accelerated a 4-year data modernization roadmap into just 6 months by standardizing on a modern data foundation with Fivetran, dbt, and Databricks. By replacing fragmented pipelines with a unified, automated data movement layer, Inova reduced data movement costs by up to 8x and cleared a backlog of 500+ requests. With near real-time, trusted data now powering decision-making across the organization, Inova is enabling faster insights, improving operations and building scalable analytics and AI applications on Databricks — creating a strong foundation for the next generation of intelligent systems.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Fivetran | Open Data Infrastructure: Built for agentic AI
sessions.body:
As AI accelerates the pace of change, demanding fresher data, diverse formats, and support across multiple engines, many teams discover their infrastructure was built for reporting, not real-time AI at scale. Open Data Infrastructure is redefining how organizations design for analytics, operations, and AI. By leveraging Fivetran as an interoperable data foundation, organizations can embrace open standards, separate storage from compute, and keep data portable across clouds and engines, preserving adaptability while scaling AI and operational workloads with Databricks. Join this session to learn how organizations:

  • Build an open, future-proof foundation that supports analytics, operations, and AI without repeated replatforming.
  • Preserve control over costs and data access as AI workloads increase in scale and complexity.
  • Design architectures that prevent platform lock-in through interoperability across ingestion, transformation, and activation.
  • See ODI brought to life in a live demo.

sessions.title: Sponsored By: Fractal | From Questions to Action: Conversational AI for Occasion‑Based Marketing
sessions.body: This presentation introduces a conversational AI–driven BI platform for marketing, designed by Fractal for occasion‑based marketing at a global snacking company. Built on Databricks, the platform uses DB Genie and AI/BI to translate plain‑English questions into governed analytics, Agent Bricks to orchestrate multi‑step reasoning and insight workflows, and Unity Catalog to ensure enterprise‑grade governance, security, and trust across data assets. The experience is further strengthened by Fractal’s behavioral sciences — which enabled personalized, data-led campaigns supported by neuroscience for emotionally resonant messaging.

sessions.title: Sponsored By: Genpact | Enabling AI-Ready Data
sessions.body: Discover how Genpact and Baker Hughes are revolutionizing data platforms with an AI-driven lakehouse designed for seamless human and agent interactions. This session will explore a four-layer approach — integrating master data for a single, trusted foundation; building ontologies to connect jobs, cash, and invoices; enabling natural language queries through a metrics layer — no SQL or analysts required; and leveraging the Agent Bricks multi-agent framework to orchestrate workflows end-to-end. Attendees will gain actionable insights into creating a unified, intelligent platform that transforms data into decisions and connects every step from job to cash.

speakers.name: Matthew Arellano
speakers.bio: Matthew Arellano is Senior Vice President at Genpact, where he leads the Databricks Business Groups, shaping the company's global strategy across data modernization, agentic AI, and enterprise platform transformation for Fortune 500 clients. Before Genpact, he co-founded XponentL Data, building next-generation data products and AI-powered accelerators that are now embedded in Genpact's Data & AI practice, and prior to that led the Global Data, Analytics and AI Strategy at Accenture. With nearly 20 years at the intersection of data, cloud, AI and enterprise transformation, Matthew brings a practitioner's perspective on how organizations move from data and AI strategy to measurable business outcomes, at scale.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Glean | From Analytics to Action: Powering Databricks Insights with Full Enterprise Context
sessions.body: Great AI answers need more than governed data alone. They need enterprise context—the people, documents, conversations, and workflows that turn an insight into action. In this session, we’ll show how Glean + Databricks bring those pieces together in one natural-language experience. With Glean connected to Databricks through Genie, employees can ask business questions in plain English and get answers grounded in Databricks governance and permissions, enriched with the broader company context around it. The result is a faster path from analytics to decisions, with trusted insights that are more accessible, more actionable, and more useful across the business. In this session, we’ll demonstrate how this unified experience works by showing how sample questions are routed from Glean to Databricks Genie, returning answers with a clear path back to the underlying data—so organizations can make data-driven decisions more accessible, trustworthy, and actionable across the business.

speakers.name: Jess Eurich
speakers.bio: Jess Eurich is a Partner Solutions Engineer at Glean.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Glean | How Enterprises Turn Databricks Data Into Everyday Value with Glean
sessions.body: Data only drives real business value when it is made actionable and accessible to everyone who needs it. See how customers are turning Databricks investments into day-to-day business value with Glean by bringing governed data together with the enterprise context needed to make it actionable. We’ll share two examples: Real estate platform Zillow’s employee-facing HR agent, which helps answer workforce questions in Slack using trusted company context and people data, and a leading automotive manufacturer’s use of Glean AI to support engineering and product workflows with easier access to structured data and company knowledge. The result: Faster self-service, fewer bottlenecks for technical teams, and more useful AI in the flow of work.

speakers.name: Jess Eurich
speakers.bio: Jess Eurich is a Partner Solutions Engineer at Glean.

sessions.title: Sponsored By: Glean | Powering Enterprise-Grade Agents: Glean and MCP for Databricks Agent Bricks
sessions.body: Databricks Agent Bricks is a powerful foundation for building agents on structured data. But enterprise questions require more than tables alone — they require deep, permission-aware context across documents, Slack, Jira, CRM systems, wikis, and institutional knowledge. In this session, we’ll show how Glean integrates with Agent Bricks to unlock the missing layer of enterprise context. By combining Databricks capabilities like Genie and Unity Catalog with Glean’s unified access to knowledge across 100+ SaaS applications, agents gain the ability to explain what happened, why it happened, and what actions to take next. We’ll cover the architecture, governance model, and real examples of agents that blend live data with enterprise knowledge to deliver more complete, actionable outcomes.

speakers.name: Aryaman Gulati
speakers.bio: Aryaman is a Product Manager, Agent Interoperability & Ecosystem at Glean.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Google | Scaling Data & AI with Efficiency: Databricks on Google Cloud Axion
sessions.body: Unlock the next generation of price-performance for your Databricks workloads. This session dives into how Google Axion Processors—Google’s custom Arm-based CPU—supercharges the Databricks Photon engine to deliver breakthrough efficiency compared to previous generations. Whether you are deploying on Classic or Serverless architectures, discover how to maximize flexibility and performance while reducingTCO across your entire data estate. We’ll share real-world customer success stories from Google Cloud and provide actionable strategies to help you scale Data and AI with unprecedented speed.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Hex | The evolution of data teams with AI analytics
sessions.body: As AI reshapes the modern data stack, data leaders face a new challenge: finding tools that serve everyone from seasoned engineers to business users who have never written a query from scratch. Hex tackles both with deep-dive analytics and conversational analytics. Mikey Flynn, Director of Core Data at Rivian, will explore how he replaced a fragmented data ecosystem, drove Hex adoption across the company, and unlocked insights across the business.

speakers.name: Barry McCardel
speakers.bio: Barry is the CEO and co-founder of Hex, the world’s most popular platform for collaborative data analysis. Prior to Hex, Barry led deployment and product teams at Palantir, working on solutions to data problems all over the world. He was then at TrialSpark/Formation, where he helped stand up their clinical trial platform. He has a B.S. from Northwestern University, where he focused on network science.

speakers.name: Michael Flynn
speakers.company: Rivian And VW Group Technology, LLC

sessions.title: Sponsored By: Hightouch | How Chick-fil-A Turns Guest Data into Caring Experiences
sessions.body: At Chick-fil-A, hospitality has always started with a warm welcome at the counter. And with a vision to be the world’s most caring company, that care now guides how the brand stewards guest data. Using Databricks and Hightouch, Chick-fil-A is building a secure guest intelligence and activation layer that can understand every visit, order, and interaction while rigorously protecting customer data. This session follows that journey — how the team brings restaurant, app, and loyalty data together in Databricks and uses Hightouch’s Composable CDP to turn trusted insights into more relevant, timely lifecycle programs and offers across channels. Attendees will leave with a vision and reference architecture for caring, data-driven guest marketing on Databricks.

speakers.name: Charma Parker
speakers.bio: With over a decade of dynamic experience in the marketing industry, Charma Parker is a seasoned expert in crafting and executing high-impact email and mobile marketing strategies. She has driven innovative campaigns for leading brands across diverse sectors, including retail companies like Carter's & OshKosh B'Gosh and Home Depot, sports and entertainment organizations such as the Atlanta Hawks & State Farm Arena, and quick-service restaurant leader, Chick-fil-A. Charma brings a wealth of practical insights and a proven track record of engaging audiences and delivering measurable results.

speakers.name: Dan MacDonnell
speakers.job_title: Sr. Lead Tech Product Owner - MarTech
speakers.bio: A senior product and MarTech leader with a track record of driving enterprise-scale customer experience transformation. As a Senior Technical Lead Product Owner at Chick-fil-A Inc., Dan leads Customer360 and marketing technology capabilities unifying customer data to enable personalization, performance measurement, and scalable decisioning across all customer touch points. A robust background that spans Wall Street (Lehman), sports media (ESPN, NBA, NCAA) and enterprise innovation (Nationwide), equips Dan with a unique ability to align data, technology, and business strategy to deliver measurable customer experiences.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Hightouch | How XP Drove a 72% Lift in Account Opens and 35% Activation Increase with Agentic CRM
sessions.body: XP is one of the largest financial institutions in Brazil, and they didn't get there by treating onboarding as a generic funnel. After proving the value of their first-party data in Databricks, XP teamed up with Hightouch to tackle a stubborn problem: millions of sign-ups that never became active accounts in traditional CRM campaigns. In this session, XP will show how they implemented Agentic CRM by turning their Databricks lakehouse into an AI decisioning engine that continuously tests offers, channels, and timing on governed first-party data, then activates those decisions in real time across XP's marketing stack via Hightouch. By putting AI decisioning at the center of onboarding, XP drove a 72% lift in account open rates and a 35% increase in activation conversion in their first few weeks—while maintaining full control of experimentation, governance, and monitoring. You'll leave with a blueprint covering data pipelines, decision policies, measurement, and cross-functional buy-in.

speakers.name: Marcelo Duarte
speakers.bio: Marcelo Duarte is a senior leader in growth, marketing, and technology at XP Inc., where he drives customer acquisition and conversion through data and Al. With a background in engineering (USP/CentraleSupélec) and an MBA from INSEAD, he combines technical depth with business impact. Marcelo is currently focused on applying Agentic Marketing strategies to optimize end-to-end marketing journeys, bridging product, data, and growth teams to unlock scalable performance gains.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: IBM | Empower AI with real-time context across hybrid data estates
sessions.body: AI agents can dramatically accelerate your ability to react to new information and make trusted decisions — but only when they have the right context from your data. However, preparing data sets for each individual AI use case is time consuming and expensive — hindered by fragmented data landscapes, inconsistent governance, and data complexity. In this session, learn how to power AI agents with real-time context from unstructured and structured data across hybrid data landscapes — without migration. Empower your AI agents, and your business, to act with confidence.

speakers.name: Ed Anuff
speakers.bio: Ed Anuff is a visionary technology leader and entrepreneur, currently leading IBM's product strategy for data as Chief Product Officer for IBM watsonx.data. He was previously Chief Product Officer at DataStax, which was acquired by IBM in 2025. With over 30 years of experience, he has shaped industry-defining products—from launching one of the first Internet search engines at Wired, founding enterprise portal pioneer Epicentric, and guiding Apigee through its IPO and acquisition by Google. His innovative approach to product strategy has made him a driving force in the evolution of data, APIs, and enterprise platforms.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: IBM | Scale AI Agents from Prototype to Production into Enterprise Systems
sessions.body: AI doesn’t deliver value in the lab — it delivers in production. In this live demo, see how IBM moves from building agents with IBM Bob to running them at scale with watsonx Orchestrate, the enterprise AI control plane.
