We’ll show how agents go from creation to real-world deployment, with full visibility, governance and control. This is what enterprise AI looks like when it’s not a pilot — but a system you can trust and scale.

speakers.name: Victor Povar
speakers.bio: Victor Povar is a watsonx Leader in IBM, he drives innovation and technical vision in cutting-edge domains such as agentic and generative AI, speech and visual recognition and process optimization, delivering impactful solutions across diverse industries including Insurance, Banking, Finance, Oil and Gas, and Healthcare.

sessions.title: Sponsored By: Immuta | How Vizient AI Transformation Starts with Scaling Data Access with Immuta
sessions.body: As organizations scale AI, the biggest barrier is often not the model — it is governed, scalable access to trusted data. In this session, Vizient shares how it is building a Data Access Framework powered by Immuta to support both human and AI consumers with secure, policy-driven access to enterprise data. The session explores how Vizient is approaching data access as a strategic capability rather than a series of manual approvals and one-off controls. Attendees will learn how Unity Catalog serves as the governance foundation for discoverability and trusted metadata, while Immuta provides dynamic policy enforcement — ensuring the right users, applications, and AI systems access only the data they are authorized to use. Attendees will leave with a practical framework for rethinking data access in their own organizations — one that supports business users, data teams, and AI systems without compromising control.

speakers.name: Charles Hatfield
speakers.bio: Charles Hatfield is Senior Director of Data Governance at Vizient Inc., where he partners with enterprise teams to deliver inclusive programs spanning data strategy, governance, and master data management — and how all of it fits into an AI-driven world. With 15+ years of experience in healthcare and financial data, Charles specializes in building the frameworks that allow organizations to use data and AI responsibly while treating data as a strategic asset. He is based in Columbus, Ohio.

speakers.name: Tyler Ditto
speakers.bio: Tyler Ditto is a Customer Success Manager at Immuta.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Impetus Technologies | Context Engineering: The New Control Plane for Agentic AI
sessions.body: Agentic AI has arrived — more capable and disruptive than ever. Yet the gap between pilot enthusiasm and operational reality is real. And behind this lies the Context Gap – the distance between what your enterprise knows and what AI knows. Discover how Impetus’ proven Context Engineering methodology bridges this gap. Learn what it really takes to make AI work – from strategic modernization & semantic awareness to agentic activation, with trust by design. Built for data & AI leaders running Databricks, the session outlines a phased path for moving from experimentation to scalable, accurate, context-aware agentic AI. Key highlights: - The anatomy of the enterprise AI Context Gap – data, semantics & execution - Why traditional context approaches like RAG and fine-tuning fall short - Transforming data into a structured context layer on Databricks using knowledge graphs, semantic models & ontologies. - How Impetus Leap™ AI Services & Solutions Family guarantees superior agentic outcomes

speakers.name: Deepak KHOSLA
speakers.bio:
Deepak Khosla is the Chief Growth Officer and AI GTM at Impetus Technologies, where he leads global growth initiatives and drives the adoption of enterprise AI, cloud, and modern data platforms. He works closely with customers and partners to help organizations modernize legacy data ecosystems, implement AI-driven solutions, and accelerate their data-to-AI transformation.

Deepak brings over two decades of experience in data analytics, artificial intelligence, and cloud transformation. Prior to Impetus, he held senior leadership roles at LTM, Infosys, and Deloitte, where he built and scaled enterprise AI and data practices and helped organizations implement large-scale data modernization programs.

He is passionate about helping enterprises unlock business value through governed, scalable, and AI-ready data platforms, and is a recognized leader in driving innovation at the intersection of data, cloud, and AI.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Impetus Technologies | Powering Context-Aware Agentic AI at Scale: Why Modernization Must Come First
sessions.body:
AI models & agents can't access, understand, or interpret enterprise data trapped in legacy silos. Enterprises must build a powerful, domain-aware context layer that reduces hallucinations and drives accurate, scalable, trustworthy agentic AI outcomes. Impetus LeapLogic Suite helps realize this by enabling automated, risk-free modernization of legacy data estates. Discover how to transform massive legacy workloads and embedded business logic into a truly AI-ready, context-aware data foundation on Databricks.

 

Session highlights:

  • Closing the Context Gap - from raw, fragmented data sources to enterprise AI that acts, reasons & self-corrects
  • Role of ontology-driven modernization & domain mapping in AI context interpretation
  • Automating modernization of legacy workloads with end-to-end lineage visibility & validation
  • Deploying production-ready, context-aware agents on Agent Bricks
  • Best practices and real-world success stories

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Imply | From Splunk to Databricks: Unlocking Open, Scalable Observability in the Lakehouse
sessions.body:
Databricks offers a lakehouse-native model for security and observability built on open formats and an open ecosystem. It enables teams to ingest, retain, and analyze large volumes of telemetry data while reducing cost and eliminating vendor lock-in. But for organizations running Splunk today, realizing this promise requires more than simply moving data.In this session, we show how teams transition from Splunk to Databricks by moving data into open lakehouse tables and querying it directly. The challenge is not storage, but making data interactive at scale. Instead of pre-indexing everything or moving data between systems, queries run in place across large historical datasets while maintaining performance. Teams can adopt the lakehouse without changing dashboards or workflows.

 

We cover how to make lakehouse data interactive, reduce infrastructure overhead, and make machine data fast and accessible for real-world observability use cases.

speakers.name: Gian Merlino
speakers.bio: Gian is co-founder and CTO at Imply, and a driving force behind Imply Lumi, an Observability Warehouse. His work focuses on keeping more data searchable at a lower cost while accelerating investigations with no workflow disruptions. Gian is one of the original authors of the open source Apache Druid® project and served as the Apache Druid project's first PMC chair. Previously, Gian led the data ingestion team at Metamarkets and held senior engineering positions at Yahoo. He holds a B.S. in Computer Science from Caltech.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Informatica | Accelerating Trusted Data for AI: Informatica’s Enterprise Data Management Solution for Databricks
sessions.body:
In the race to AI adoption, data management emerges as the critical enabler that transforms raw data into an actionable asset. Informatica delivers data management agents and an agentic workflow framework that accelerates the operationalization of agents built on Agent Bricks. By unifying all enterprise data assets for a 360-degree view - validated, governed and enriched with business context, Databricks customers on an agentic transformation journey can experience faster agent deployments and shorter time to value, with no data left behind and easier adherence to compliance mandates.

 

In this session, you will:

  • Explore trends and data management strategies for turning fragmented data into trusted data intelligence
  • Learn how you can leverage Informatica-managed MCP servers for governance and master data management (MDM) in your agentic workflows
  • Find out how you can accelerate data readiness for your Agent Bricks agents

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Informatica | Govern Like You Mean It: Centralized Governance, Security and Compliance for Databricks and Beyond
sessions.body:
Holistic data governance is not only for keeping compliance officers happy, it’s also imperative for data democratization, improving analytics and AI, and unlocking new revenue streams. Informatica’s Cloud Data Governance & Catalog is validated with Unity Catalog and adds enterprise awareness through broad connectivity, business metadata, lineage and an enterprise catalog to deliver centralized and holistic governance across the entire enterprise data estate.

 

This session covers:

  • Governance and Data Catalog: Enable data discovery, lineage tracking, data quality, and compliance workflows including integrated metadata management with Unity Catalog
  • Data Marketplace: Improve accessibility, collaboration, trust, transparency and compliance for shared data assets
  • Data Quality and Observability: Build high-quality data pipelines and drive effective decision making with data quality tools that monitors and optimizes data with anomaly detection, data lineage, and real-time monitoring

sessions.title: Sponsored By: Informatica | Unlocking AI-Ready Data: How To Transform Pharmaceutical Research with Informatica and Databricks
sessions.body:
Fragmented, inconsistent data is one of the biggest barriers to AI in life sciences. In this session, learn how to use Informatica MDM to build a unified, AI-ready data foundation on the Databricks platform.

 

We'll cover:

  • Golden records on Databricks
  • How Informatica MDM unifies disparate data sources into a single, authoritative record; enabling AI in life sciences
  • How governed master data unlocks AI/ML workloads across clinical research and drug safety; MDM for pharmaceutical research
  • How Informatica MDM's matching, merging, and survivorship capabilities solve real pharmaceutical research challenges at scale. 

 

Walk away with a concrete blueprint for turning messy enterprise data into a competitive advantage.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Infosys | Delivering Industry-scale AI on Databricks
sessions.body: AI-powered demand forecasting solution: It delivers short, mid, and long-term forecasts using an intelligent demand-sensing engine that adapts to smooth, lumpy, and intermittent demand patterns. Production Optimization: As oil and gas operators strive to maximize asset recovery, continuously monitoring well performance against forecasts is critical. This session explores how Infosys engineered a highly scalable Decline Curve Analysis (DCA) and production surveillance solution on the Databricks Platform.

speakers.name: neeraj dixit
speakers.bio: Neeraj Dixit is Senior Industry Principal in Analytics Consulting at Infosys. He brings 23+ years of experience of implementing scaled solution leveraging artificial intelligence and advance data science models. Some of his accomplishments are building predictive models, machine learning led data harmonization and anomaly detection models leveraging Databricks implementations across industry segments.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Infosys | From Systems of Record to Systems of Action: The Path to the Agentic Enterprise
sessions.body: As enterprises reimagine business applications and systems of record, the focus is shifting from systems that record to systems that act — powered by Agentic AI. But the path to the Agentic Enterprise is not paved by better models alone. It requires a new enterprise architecture built for intelligence, autonomy, governance, and trust. The bottleneck is not enterprise imagination — it is enterprise readiness. Most organizations are not yet equipped with the real-time data fabric, orchestration patterns, domain intelligence, contextual knowledge, and governance frameworks that agentic systems require to operate safely and effectively. Multi-agent systems will reshape more than technology stacks; they will rewire business processes, redefine enterprise architecture, and reset the boundaries of human judgment, accountability, and control.

speakers.name: Rajan Padmanabhan
speakers.bio: Rajan is the Head of Solutions & Innovations for Data, Analytics & AI. He has 4 Patents in the areas of Surround Data and AI. He has over 22 years of experience cutting across multiple industry domains, helping Fortune 500 clients to envision , strategize , innovate, and industrialize with AI @ Scale.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Infosys | Scaling Modernization: How Industry Leaders are Accelerating Adoption of AI-ready Lakehouse
sessions.body: Enterprises across industries are racing to modernize legacy data platforms while simultaneously preparing for the GenAI era. However, the path to modernization varies widely, depending on industry, operating model, governance requirements, and AI ambitions. In this cross-industry panel, leaders from multiple Fortune-level organizations share practical insights on modernizing with Infosys and Databricks to build AI-ready data platforms that deliver predictable, measurable value. Panelists will discuss proven techniques, lessons learnt, and what ultimately unlocked AI readiness at enterprise scale. This includes modernization catalysts, architectural decisions, migration patterns, automation strategies, governance uplift, and aligning transformation with business outcomes. Infosys will moderate the conversation using its Infosys DE.ai modernization factory framework, enabling panelists to reflect on common accelerators and industry-specific challenges.

speakers.name: Julie Nguyen
speakers.bio:
- Finalist for Data Leader of the year 2021, Women in IT Award
-Working at bp for 21 years and have spent most of her career in Trading and Shipping. Started in Digital before working in risk management for bp Trading and then moving back to Digital! During these 21 years, the one discipline that has remained at the heart of her work is data
- Oversee a team of more than 200 data engineers and over 100 projects across the organization.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Insight| Beyond the Sandbox: Using Lakebase Instant Branching for High-Stakes AI Agent Deployment
sessions.body: As AI agents evolve from chat-based assistants into autonomous systems, the cost of data errors and unintended actions grows. How do you let an agent update pricing or modify records without exposing production systems safely? Enter Lakebase. In this session, we demonstrate a safety‑first architecture using Lakebase’s serverless Postgres and Instant Branching capabilities. You’ll see a live demo of an Autonomous Pricing Agent responding to real-time market signals. Instead of writing directly to production, the agent triggers an Instant Branch — a zero‑copy, isolated clone of the operational database created in seconds. Here, we run automated pre‑flight validations, business rules, and AI/BI impact analysis before selectively merging approved changes back to the primary database. Attendees will learn how to implement Git‑for‑Data style workflows, manage agent state and memory using pgvector, and continuously sync changes using Lakehouse Sync for auditability and downstream analytics.

speakers.name: Jerid Fortney
speakers.bio:
Jerid is a Data Architect at Insight, helping enterprise clients design and operate modern data platforms across the Microsoft and Databricks ecosystems. His expertise spans Azure Databricks, Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Unity Catalog, and Azure data services, with a focus on the architecture decisions that determine whether a platform scales or collapses under governance debt.
His current work sits at the intersection of lakehouse architecture and applied GenAI — RAG pipelines, MLflow and Mosaic AI agents, and the Unity Catalog governance to keep them production-ready. A returning speaker, he presented at FabCon 2025 and 2026.
When he's not architecting data platforms, you'll find him under a barbell at his local CrossFit box.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Keebo | Teach Your Warehouse to Drive Itself: Cutting Costs with Reinforcement Learning on Databricks SQL
sessions.body: Databricks SQL has transformed how teams interact with their data, delivering fast query performance, seamless scalability, and a lakehouse architecture that brings together the best of data warehousing and data engineering. It’s an incredibly powerful platform, but getting the most out of it requires constant attention to cost and performance. Warehouse workloads are dynamic. Query demands shift around the clock, teams grow, and what was perfectly tuned last week may be wasteful or underperforming today. Maximizing efficiency on Databricks SQL is not a one-time task. It’s an ongoing challenge. That’s where Keebo comes in. In this session, we’ll show how Keebo uses reinforcement learning to learn your unique workload patterns and continuously optimize your Databricks SQL warehouses in real time, maximizing performance while reducing costs. No manual tuning. No trade-offs. Just a warehouse that gets smarter over time.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: KPMG | Activation of Agentic AI in Data Engineering Leveraging Databricks Agent Bricks
sessions.body: As organizations accelerate their AI and data strategies, traditional data engineering faces growing challenges around scale, complexity and the need for real-time insights. This session will explore how agentic AI, powered by Databricks Agent Bricks, is redefining modern data engineering through autonomous, goal-driven agents that streamline data ingestion, transformation, quality management and orchestration across the data lifecycle. You’ll learn how Agent Bricks activates intelligent agents within the Databricks ecosystem to automate complex data workflows, strengthen governance and accelerate the delivery of trusted, AI-ready data products at enterprise scale.

speakers.name: Bindu Birur
speakers.job_title: Head of Data Eng & Analytics Delivery
speakers.bio:
Head of Data Engineering & Analytics Delivery Excellence at KPMG. Recognized for over 25+ years of leadership in AI, Data Analytics, BI, and Digital Transformation. Known by executives and peers as a results-driven “hustler”, Strategic vision blends technical depth with strong business acumen.
Orchestrates global teams to deliver end-to-end data solutions, from Data Fabric architectures to enterprise data lakes, ensuring seamless integration of internal and external big data sources.
Built high-performing organizations that embrace innovation, agile practices, and best-in-class technologies. Portfolio spans healthcare, finance, and professional services, consistently demonstrating the power of data-driven insights

sessions.title: Sponsored by: KPMG | Building a Governed Synthetic Data Lakehouse for AI Agents
sessions.body: Synthetic data + AI agents is very hot for Databricks right now. The objective of the talk is to propose exploring the idea of synthetic Lakehouse designed specifically for AI agents rather than traditional approach to data collection. The motivation is that teams want to build and evaluate agents over conversations, documents, tickets, and knowledge bases, but real enterprise data is often sensitive or regulated, which blocks experimentation and validation. We will show how synthetic data can be used as a safe, realistic test to develop and evaluate production grade AI agents. We will explore how to design agent-ready synthetic data and why a synthetic Lakehouse is a practical foundation for testing agents even before touching real data.

speakers.name: Fabiana Clemente
speakers.bio: Fabiana Clemente is a Distinguished Engineer at KPMG, where she leads the Synthetic Data Center of Excellence. She co-founded YData and served as its CTO, taking a synthetic data platform from idea to a successful exit. With published research in Generative AI and as former core maintainer of the open-source ydata-profiling (114 million downloads), she has been a hands-on builder at the intersection of data quality, privacy, and AI. Fabiana is a regular conference speaker and previously hosted the MLOps Community podcast When Privacy Meets Machine Learning. She is particularly interested in privacy-preserving AI techniques and what it takes to make AI systems that organizations can trust with their most sensitive data.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: LakeFusion | When MDM Meets Ontology: A New Architecture for Enterprise Data Intelligence
sessions.body: Every enterprise has data. But most struggle to extract true meaning. We've spent decades building separate systems for analytics and operations, separate tools for data quality and governance, separate platforms for master data and transactional data. The result: fragmented records, conflicting hierarchies and business processes that can't trust the data they depend on. This talk introduces the concept of an operational ontology: a data architecture that doesn't just describe what your data should look like, but enforces it at scale, in real time, inside the lakehouse. Drawing from production deployments that consolidated 100M+ records across dozens of source systems in weeks (not months), we'll show how LakeFusion’s lakehouse-native entity resolution, streaming data quality, and AI-powered stewardship combine to build something traditional MDM and top-down knowledge graphs never could: a living, governed, operational model of your business that AI agents can actually act on.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Lovelytics | Automating High-Stakes Finance Workflows with AI Agents
sessions.body: Finance back office teams spend significant time on manual, document-heavy workflows like remittance reconciliation and proof of delivery validation. We present how we deployed two production-grade automation use cases for Lippert, saving 250+ hours monthly with over 90% model accuracy. We first cover remittance reconciliation from lockbox PDFs spanning hundreds of pages. The solution uses a deterministic extraction pipeline that segments documents, normalizes headers, cleans OCR noise, validates line items and applies customer enrichment to produce finance-ready tables and exception-focused audit trails. Next, we detail proof of delivery automation, where standard OCR struggles with crossed-out quantities and signatures. This use case combines computer vision and LLMs using Azure Document Intelligence and OpenCV smart cropping with a safety-first validation layer. We share design tradeoffs, failure modes and lessons learned from deploying finance agents in production.

speakers.name: Sudhir Gajre
speakers.bio: Sudhir Gajre is the Managing Director of the AI and GenAI Practice at Lovelytics, where he leads the Generative AI practice. He brings over 20 years of consulting experience, driving complex data and AI transformations across industries including healthcare, financial services, media, insurance, and retail. Sudhir also serves as an Adjunct Professor at the University of Nebraska at Omaha and is a member of the Databricks Technical Council. A frequent conference speaker and blogger on GenAI and Databricks, he is known for turning innovation into impact through hands-on expertise and practical frameworks that bridge strategy and execution.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Lovelytics | Rebuilding Data & Identity at Scale: Acxiom's Platform Transformation
sessions.body:
In this session, Acxiom and Lovelytics share how they partnered with Databricks to rebuild Data & Identity services as a native application layer on the Databricks Data Intelligence Platform. Attendees will learn how standardizing identity across first-, second-, and third-party data, leveraging Databricks clean rooms, and enabling zero-data-movement architectures improved performance, accelerated innovation, and enabled secure collaboration. The session showcases a real-world industry use case demonstrating measurable impact.

 

Acxiom, an Omnicom company, is a leading provider in data, identity, and marketing technology, supporting organizations in leveraging customer data at scale.

 

Lovelytics is the largest pureplay Databricks consulting partner, with a proven track record of delivering over $2B in measurable business value across 500+ successful projects.

speakers.name: Ankur Jain
speakers.bio: Ankur is Chief Cloud and Data Modernization Officer at Acxiom. Ankur leads Acxiom's product and data engineering transformation by leveraging public cloud platforms, modern architectures, and artificial intelligence to enhance performance, scalability, and security. His focus is to help clients modernize their mar-tech stack, support their in-housing initiatives, and enable personalization at scale.

speakers.name: Jay Goebel
speakers.bio: Jay is the Industry Lead for the Communications, Media, and Entertainment practice at Lovelytics. Jay leads strategic initiatives focused on helping organizations differentiate in the market through cloud platforms, artificial intelligence, and deep industry expertise. His focus is on helping clients modernize their data and analytics ecosystems, accelerate innovation, and build scalable solutions that drive business growth. Jay also leads internal efforts to develop market-ready solutions and accelerators that advance Lovelytics’ capabilities across AI and cloud transformation.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: LTM | Accelerating Operational Resilience at Scale - 7-Eleven’s Integration of Databricks and Agentic AI
sessions.body: At 7-Eleven, operational resilience at scale depends on how quickly data can be converted into action. With thousands of stores generating structured sensor telemetry, equipment failures can directly impact revenue, yet traditional development approaches were too slow to scale predictive maintenance solutions efficiently. This session explores how 7-Eleven accelerated ML delivery using Databricks and an agentic AI–driven workflow. Built on Delta tables and a medallion architecture, the solution enabled scalable ingestion, governed access, and ML-based failure detection. Using Windsurf, GitLab, and Databricks Asset Bundles, the team significantly accelerated code generation, integration, and deployment. The end-to-end solution was delivered in under two weeks versus an estimated six weeks, reducing development effort, accelerating time-to-market, and helping protect millions in revenue.

speakers.name: Rajeshkumar RS
speakers.bio: Rajeshkumar is a Principal Architect with over 20 years of experience in designing and engineering enterprise data applications. He specializes in building end-to-end data pipelines across on-premise and Azure cloud environments, helping organizations modernize data platforms and accelerate scalable analytics and AI initiatives.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Microsoft | Unlocking the Microsoft Data & AI Ecosystem with Azure Databricks: From Insight to Impact
sessions.body: In today’s data-driven landscape, organizations need more than analytics—they need a unified platform that turns raw data into actionable intelligence across the Microsoft ecosystem. This session explores how Azure Databricks serves as the backbone of modern data architecture, integrating with Microsoft Entra ID, Foundry, Agent 365, Power BI, and Microsoft Fabric to accelerate innovation. Learn how to use Azure Databricks for scalable data engineering, advanced analytics, and AI-driven solutions while enabling real-time collaboration and governance. Through practical examples and architectural patterns, we’ll show how to eliminate data silos, optimize performance, and empower teams to deliver insights faster. Whether building pipelines, deploying ML models, or enhancing BI, this session provides the strategies and tools needed to unlock the full potential of your Microsoft data ecosystem.

sessions.title: Sponsored By: MinIO | How a Fortune 500 Manufacturer Runs Databricks AI on 250 TB of On-Premises Data
sessions.body: A Fortune 500 semiconductor manufacturer generates hundreds of terabytes of production data across facilities in two international regions. That data must stay on-premises for regulatory compliance, latency sensitivity, and economics of scale — but the data science team depends on Databricks for the AI modeling that drives yield improvement and quality assurance. Rather than replicating data to the cloud or building custom ETL pipelines, they deployed MinIO AIStor with native Delta Sharing embedded at the storage layer. Databricks queries live Delta and Iceberg tables on-premises through Unity Catalog with zero data movement — no copies, no pipelines, no additional infrastructure. In this session, hear how the solution was architected, what decisions were made and why, and what the team learned operating it in production. Includes perspectives from MinIO and Databricks, a technical walkthrough, and a live demo of AIStor Table Sharing connected to a Databricks workspace.

speakers.name: Denis Dubeau
speakers.bio: Denis Dubeau is a Principal Partner Engineer and a seasoned professional with significant industry experience. He currently leads the partner engineering efforts for the Software-Defined Storage and Security Open Lakehouse partner ecosystem.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: MinIO | On-Prem to Databricks: Zero-Copy Analytics with Native Delta Sharing for Iceberg and Delta Lake
sessions.body:
Organizations need to give Databricks direct access to on-premises data without copying it or building pipelines. Traditional approaches introduce duplication, complexity, and risk, especially when sovereignty or latency requirements prevent cloud movement. AIStor Table Sharing is MinIO's native Delta Sharing protocol implementation embedded in the AIStor binary, delivering streamlined administration, consistency, and full governance while enabling secure, read-only access for consumers such as Databricks.

 

Key highlights:

  • Native Delta Lake and Apache Iceberg table support
  • Authentication via bearer tokens and OAuth2/OIDC
  • Zero-downtime share, schema, and table administration
  • Bare-metal, containerized, and hybrid deployment support
  • Practical guidance deploying with Databricks

 

Attendees will learn how AIStor Table Sharing eliminates data movement, reduces egress costs, enforces granular security, and enables hybrid analytics while keeping data under organizational control.

sessions.title: Sponsored By: Monte Carlo | Building the Foundation for Trusted AI in Regulated Industries
sessions.body: The enterprises with the most to gain from AI are often the slowest to deploy it, and in regulated industries, that caution is rational — the risk is real. Data quality failures don't just break pipelines in financial services — they break compliance, erode model trust, and end careers. The bar for "production-ready" AI is fundamentally different when your data touches trades, audits, or PII. In this session, Barr Moses, CEO of Monte Carlo, joins Lenny Rosenfeld, VP of Data Science & Software Engineering at Nasdaq, for a conversation on what it takes to get trusted AI into production in financial services. They'll cover AI observability, data lineage, and governance frameworks built for regulators — sharing the failures they've seen, the patterns that work, and what they'd do differently.

speakers.name: Barr Moses
speakers.bio: Barr Moses is the CEO and Co-founder of Monte Carlo, the lead of the data observability category backed by Accel, GGV, Redpoint, ICONIQ Growth, Salesforce Ventures, IVP, and other top Silicon Valley investors. Monte Carlo works with companies such as Cisco, American Airlines, and NASDAQ to help them drive positive business outcomes with reliable data and AI.

speakers.name: Leonid Rosenfeld
speakers.bio: Leonid (Lenny) Rosenfeld is the head of engineering for market data, alternative data, and data intelligence platforms at Nasdaq. He boasts 20+ years of turning ideas into reality, leading technology teams through all stages of growth. His experience includes data-intensive computing, AI,  applied analytics, and distributed systems.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Monte Carlo | Building Trusted AI on Certifiable Data Assets at American Airlines
sessions.body: At American Airlines, trusted data is the runway for business value. In this session, Andrew Machen, Head of Data Governance at American Airlines, will share how his team stood up a full governance program—establishing operating models, policies, committees, and certifiable data assets—in just over a year to ensure data is ready for scale. By certifying underlying data assets, American ensures every dataset meets rigorous quality and governance standards. He’ll share how data + AI observability plays a key role in monitoring and validating data health, enabling data stewards and engineers to focus less on manual oversight and more on driving impact. He’ll also dive into how his team is extending their program to AI governance to deliver measurable AI outcomes, accelerate trusted AI enablement, and generate early returns.

speakers.name: Andrew Machen
speakers.bio: Andrew has 25 years experience dealing with data across multiple industries.  In his last 11 years will American Airlines he has worked through the changing operational and analytics data landscape through the largest airline merger in history.  In the last few years he has focused on creating a community of hundreds that is passionate about making data as fast and easy as possible.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Monte Carlo | Why Your Agents Keep Failing (And What to Do About It)
sessions.body: Every company is shipping AI agents right now. Most of them are failing, and nobody knows until a customer or an exec calls it out. The problem isn't the models. It's that teams are building agents on top of data they don't monitor, running them without observability, and trusting outputs no one has tested. In this session, I'll walk through the three places agents actually break in production: the data going in, the agent's own behavior, and what comes out the other side. I'll share a framework for catching these failures before your users do. The goal is simple: stop shipping pilots that quietly die, and start shipping agents that hold up when it matters.

speakers.name: Barr Moses
speakers.bio: Barr Moses is the CEO and Co-founder of Monte Carlo, the lead of the data observability category backed by Accel, GGV, Redpoint, ICONIQ Growth, Salesforce Ventures, IVP, and other top Silicon Valley investors. Monte Carlo works with companies such as Cisco, American Airlines, and NASDAQ to help them drive positive business outcomes with reliable data and AI.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Moveworks | The end of standalone analytics: How AI is merging insight and action
sessions.body: Analytics as a standalone category is changing fast. As AI closes the distance between systems of intelligence and systems of action, the old model — generate insight, hand it off, hope someone acts — is breaking down. In this session, Florian Schouten, GVP of Product Management for Workflow Analytics at ServiceNow, explores what comes next: a world where AI continuously surfaces insights from your Databricks data and triggers automated workflows before a human even opens a dashboard. See how ServiceNow and Pyramid Analytics are making this vision real — combining governed, AI-powered analytics with the workflow automation that turns data into measurable enterprise outcomes. If you're building on Databricks and wondering what the future of analytics looks like, this session is for you.

speakers.name: Florian Schouten
speakers.bio:
Florian Schouten is GVP of Product Management, Workflow Data Analytics at ServiceNow, where he leads the analytics product portfolio across the platform. His career spans three decades and a consistent mission: turning complex data into clear, actionable decisions.
Florian has built and shipped pioneering analytics products at companies ranging from venture-backed startups to large public enterprises — including ThoughtSpot, Mode Analytics, Digital.ai, and Oracle (via PeopleSoft), where he led a $1B+ analytics applications business. He holds advanced degrees from Tilburg University and Delft University of Technology, and lives in the Boston area.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Nagarro | The Agentic Enterprise: What has to be True Before AI can Act Autonomously
sessions.body:
Most companies have shipped AI by now: copilots, dashboards, recommendation engines. The models work, the data platforms exist, yet AI still usually sits behind a human. It advises, but rarely acts. That gap comes down to orchestration, governance and organization design. This session will explore what must be in place before AI can run autonomously, and what changes when it does. We’ll walk through enterprise scenarios where agentic AI runs on a Databricks backbone, and the architecture and governance choices that made it possible. We’ll also cover where human oversight still belongs and it's importance.

 

Highlights:

  • Why AI programs get stuck between "working demo" and "running in production," and what closes that gap
  • Walkthrough of agentic workflows on Databricks including decision movement between AI and people
  • Nagarro's Fluidic Intelligence framework for treating AI as a continuous system
  • What leadership teams need to start doing as well as stop doing

speakers.name: Anurag Sahay
speakers.job_title: Managing Director & Head of Data and AI
speakers.bio:
Anurag leads global data and AI services at Nagarro. As a trusted advisor to senior business leaders, he brings extensive strategy, technology, and client experience to his role and spearheads data and AI-powered transformation initiatives across industries and enterprise functions. 

He is a recognized thought leader on data and AI, and his insights on scaling enterprise AI, AI governance, and digital transformation frequently feature in industry articles, interviews, technology forums and events. An alumnus of IIT Delhi, he has held leadership roles at IBM, Microsoft, and Nokia and is deeply committed to inclusion and mentoring emerging talent.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Neo4j | Financial Crime Hides Between the Rows
sessions.body: Fraud rings do not announce themselves in a single row. They hide two or three hops away from the obvious suspects, woven into transactions that look ordinary until you trace the full network. The analyst tools stay the same, what changes is what the data reveals. Your Databricks Lakehouse already holds the data. What it lacks is a way to traverse it as a connected graph. We walk through a live fraud investigation and show how Neo4j turns days of manual analysis into a query Databricks Genie answers in seconds. The hidden patterns do not stay hidden once they become columns. Neo4j scores every account; those scores land in your Lakehouse as ordinary dimensions. Databricks Genie needs no changes; it queries graph scores the same way it queries region or balance. Before enrichment: a flat list. After: accounts at the center of distinct fraud communities. Attendees leave with the notebook and graph data model on GitHub to replicate this on their Delta Lake data.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Neurealm | AI driven Approach to Accelerate Data Modernization by up to 25%
sessions.body: Enterprises often struggle with slow, manual data migrations & fragmented data quality processes, limiting their ability to adopt AI at scale. This session introduces our approach to data modernization driven by our framework of ‘NeuFlow,’ an autonomous, no-code data engineering approach designed to accelerate data journeys and deliver AI-ready data. Our approach towards AI driven Data modernization unifies intelligent migration (DataBridge), automated data quality (TrustFlow) and reconciliation (MatchFlow) into a single AI-powered framework represented by Neuflow. Attendees will learn how organizations can reduce migration timelines by up to 25%, automate nearly 50% of data quality operations, and achieve 20–30% lower operational costs, while improving trust, governance, and readiness for AI-driven use cases.

speakers.name: Pragadeesh J
speakers.bio:
Pragadeesh J is a data leader with 22+ years of experience, including 5+ years specializing in Databricks and Lakehouse architectures. As Director of Data Engineering at Neurealm, he leads large-scale migrations and AI-ready data initiatives for regulated sectors like healthcare.
A Databricks Certified Data Engineer Professional, Pragadeesh merges technical mastery with strategic leadership to build scalable, governed platforms. He is the architect of NeuFlow, an autonomous, no-code framework that accelerates migrations and enhances engineering efficiency. His expertise focuses on driving measurable business impact through automated workflows and robust data governance, ensuring organizations are primed for the AI era.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Nimble Gravity | When Agents Should Ask for Help: Designing Human Escalation in Agent Bricks
sessions.body: Autonomous agents can handle a lot, until they can't. The real challenge isn't building an agent that runs, it's building one that knows when to stop and who to ask. In this session, we walk through a practical pattern for connecting AI agents to the humans they work alongside, without pulling those people out of their day. Using Agent Bricks, Databricks-native AI functions, and MLflow evaluation, we show how an agent can assess its outputs, escalate to colleagues when needed (via Teams or Slack), and continue autonomously once it has what it needs. Through a live demo, you'll see the full cycle: an agent processes and reasons over documents, evaluates its own work, routes targeted questions to people, handles partial and non-responses gracefully, and logs timing and feedback for future improvement. You'll leave with a reusable pattern for building agents that augment human decision-making and a clear picture of how Databricks makes the oversight layer part of the platform.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: NTT Data | From Months to Days: Using AI DevKit to Democratize Data Development and Accelerate Insights
sessions.body: Every data team rebuilds the same infrastructure. The same pipelines, the same mapping, the same delivery bottlenecks — sprint after sprint. What should take weeks takes months, and the gap between business intent and production-ready data only widens. At NTT DATA, we changed the equation. In this session, Anvesh Vallabhaneni shares how NTT DATA extended the Databricks AI Dev Kit — transforming natural language inputs like requirements docs and meeting transcripts into fully governed, production-ready Databricks artifacts across pipelines, Unity Catalog, AI/BI dashboards, and Model Serving. Projects that demanded months of specialized engineering now ship in days. Less code. Less dependency on specialized talent. More governed, AI-ready data at enterprise scale. Leaders will leave with a clear understanding of how AI-assisted development compresses time-to-insight, reduces engineering overhead, and enables data platforms to scale without scaling headcount.

sessions.title: Sponsored By: NTT Data | Powering the Grid: Southern Company, NTT DATA, and Databricks' Modern Data and AI Foundation
sessions.body: Southern Company's Power Delivery, with NTT DATA and Databricks, is building a modern data and AI foundation for the utility grid of the future. This session features Shane Powell and Greg Stuhlman, sharing the evolution of their multi-year collaboration from early analytics modernization to a future lakehouse-driven architecture. NTT DATA leveraged its global Databricks partnership to co-engineer utility-specific solutions. Recent successes include a modernized insights application reducing data load times from 15 minutes to under 3 seconds through redesigned data models, optimized compute, and modern React front end. The session explores AI readiness through improved data quality, governance, and lineage — enabling intelligent grid applications, fleet safety, and AI forecasting while maintaining regulatory rigor. Attendees will learn architectural decisions and lessons from building scalable data infrastructure for regulated enterprises.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Omni | AI analytics at Condé Nast: What it took to get to production
sessions.body: Using Databricks and Omni, Condé Nast encoded business logic into a governed semantic layer and trained the system on how teams define performance, interpret metrics, and make decisions. Built on a rigorous AI orchestration framework, AI now generates campaign takeaways, surfaces performance drivers, and automatically guides recommendations across teams. This session explores the interplay between analytics and AI and the requirements for moving a solution into production.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Omni | How BambooHR Built a Branded AI data Product for 100K Users
sessions.body: BambooHR transformed their in-app analytics offering with Omni. In four months, BambooHR launched Elite Analytics on Databricks and Omni, reaching 100,000+ users, boosting reporting satisfaction by 15%, and creating a new upsell path. All without diverting engineering from their core roadmap. In this session, they share how a semantic layer made it possible to scale AI-powered analytics across their customer base.

speakers.name: Thomas Stockham
speakers.bio: Thomas Stockham is the Group Product Manager, Data & AI at BambooHR.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Onehouse | From JVM Gymnastics to Vectorized Performance in One K8s Operator Deploy
sessions.body: You open the Apache Spark™ UI and watch your executors doing full JVM gymnastics. Heap/off-heap flips, Tungsten memory juggling, GC pauses and shuffle spills everywhere. Dynamic allocation struggles, podTemplate nightmares and memoryOverhead prayers are the daily norm. In this 20-minute lightning talk I’ll show you how to drop a new Kubernetes Operator into your Spark-on-K8s cluster and instantly unlock a high-performance vectorized native execution engine. Zero code changes, no new APIs, no rewrites. You’ll see exactly how the operator reconciles every SparkApplication CR and SparkExecutorPod, replacing the JVM gymnastics with true native performance. Plus real production results: 3x+ faster workloads and 40-60% lower cloud spend. Leave with a clear, actionable playbook to upgrade Spark on Kubernetes in one operator deploy.

speakers.name: Kyle Weller
speakers.bio: Kyle Weller has been building data platforms and data products for over 10 years. He currently runs product development at Onehouse.ai building a Universal Data Lakehouse that automates data platforms to run on Apache Hudi, Delta Lake, and Apache Iceberg. Before Onehouse, Kyle was a Product Lead for Azure Databricks, he built AI products with AzureML, and has architected several planet scale data engineering platforms for Cortana, Bing, Office. Kyle has seen how hard it is for data engineers to build DIY data lakes and he looks forward to the rise of the managed Lakehouse. Outside of work Kyle volunteers as an entrepreneurship coach for incarcerated individuals.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: OneTrust | Operationalizing the DASF: Reducing AI Risk with Runtime Enforcement
sessions.body: As organizations scale data and AI initiatives on Databricks, speed and trust must advance together. This session explores how modern enterprises can operationalize trusted data and AI by combining security principles with actionable governance guardrails. Learn how the Databricks Data and AI Security Framework can be extended with policy‑driven controls that ensure consistent access, use, and governance of data across analytics and AI workflows. Join us for this discussion and live demo to see how guardrails can be applied across the AI lifecycle to help organizations manage risk, respect data‑use requirements, and demonstrate compliance without disrupting innovation. Attendees will gain practical insight into turning governance from static policies into enforceable, auditable controls that scale with Databricks — enabling confident, responsible data and AI initiatives at enterprise scale.

speakers.name: David Wells
speakers.bio:
David Wells is a Senior Specialist Solutions Architect at Databricks, where he supports enterprise clients in building scalable, analytics-driven data platforms. With a background in data fusion, organizational design, and cross-functional analytics enablement, he brings deep experience from the financial services sector.

Recently, David developed the Databricks AI Governance Framework, a pragmatic, adaptable approach to AI governance designed to help organizations align teams, tools, and data around shared principles, enabling innovation and control in complex data environments.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Perficient | From Second Gear to Full Throttle: Unlocking Trapped Value in Your Databricks Investment
sessions.body: Most Databricks customers are driving a race car in second gear—access to 12+ products while actively using only 2-3. The problem isn't adoption; it's activation. This session reveals how one organization transformed from standard data engineering to full platform activation, lighting up a dozen products without platform migration. Through two parallel workstreams, we'll explore the journey from foundational data engineering to production-ready agentic AI. The first workstream demonstrates real-time Customer 360 integration, moving from batch reports to sub-100ms queryable APIs. The second showcases autonomous AI agents performing production work humans cannot do at scale—all governed by the same Unity Catalog managing traditional data assets. You'll learn the utilization gap framework, pattern-based approaches that replaced 20-30 weeks of bespoke engineering, and proof that the path from data engineering to agentic AI doesn't require buying more—it requires using what you own.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Pogo | You're Overthinking It: What Analyzing $500B in Consumer Spend Taught Us About Building AI Agents
sessions.body: At Pogo, we built AI research agents to help brands analyze hundreds of billions in consumer spending data. Our biggest lesson: the breakthrough came after we threw most of it away. We started with a complex system of specialized agents. It was fragile, unreliable, and impossible to iterate on. When we simplified to a single agent, everything changed. In this session, we’ll share why simpler agent architectures dramatically outperform complex ones, what the frontier AI labs’ own designs reveal about where the industry is heading, and how this approach powers Pogo’s AI research agent — where brands analyze purchase data from 3M Americans and interview thousands of verified buyers through an AI video interviewer, with results in hours.

speakers.name: Luke Morgan-Scott
speakers.bio: Luke Morgan-Scott is the Head of Data at Pogo. Pogo’s AI Qual platform allows brands to find and conduct video interviews with thousands of purchase verified shoppers simultaneously within an hour. Pogo’s app helps 3M users monetize their SKU-level purchase data, capturing 1 in 150 shopping trips in America. Pogo has raised over $32m from top VCs, and has been ranked as the #1 loyalty app in America by Newsweek in 2024 and 2025.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Polestar Analytics | Real-Time Working Capital on Databricks: From Siloed P2P, O2C & Inventory to Cash Flow Action
sessions.body: Over $1.8 trillion remains trapped in working capital globally - not due to a lack of data, but because that data is fragmented, delayed, and disconnected from decision-making. Most finance teams operate across siloed P2P, O2C, and inventory systems - each capturing only part of the picture. The gaps between them are where visibility is lost and cash leakage begins. This session is about closing that gap on the Databricks platform. We'll walk through how - To unify P2P, O2C, and inventory data into a single, governed financial model using Delta Lake and Unity Catalog. - Lakebase enables real-time querying across that unified layer. - Mosaic AI continuously monitors working capital metrics like DSO, DPO, and cash conversion cycle, detects anomalies as they emerge, diagnoses root causes, and surfaces corrective actions. So, instead of reacting to static reports, finance teams get a closed-loop system: detect, diagnose, simulate, and execute - enabling faster, data-driven action at scale

speakers.name: Alex Sidarenka
speakers.bio: Alex Sidarenka is a strategic alliances leader at Polestar Analytics with deep expertise in Cloud, Data, and AI ecosystems. Alex has spent his career building and scaling high-impact partnerships across the technology sector - leading Cloud, Data & AI alliances, and across multiple enterprise software ventures. He holds Databricks certifications in Gen AI & LLM, bringing hands-on platform fluency to his partnership work. At Polestar Analytics, Alex focuses on driving go-to-market success through the Databricks alliance, translating joint capabilities into real enterprise outcomes.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Precisely | Architecting Agentic-Ready Data Pipelines with Databricks and Precisely
sessions.body: Agentic AI is accelerating how enterprises operate and make decisions, but most data isn't ready to support it. High-value customer data is buried in unstructured sources — support tickets, call center transcripts, and scanned documents — creating a gap where agents act fast but not always correctly. In this session, we show how Precisely and Databricks Agent Bricks transform this untapped data into agentic-ready data: accessible, contextualized, current, reliable, governed, and automated — so AI agents can act, decide, and execute with accuracy and confidence. Using a multi-agent architecture on Databricks, we demonstrate how free-form text becomes structured information. We extract key customer attributes and improve record integrity using Precisely's native capabilities for data integration, quality, governance, location intelligence, and enrichment—embedded directly into Databricks pipelines via native UDFs, unifying structured and unstructured data to ensure accuracy and reliability.

speakers.name: Mayank Kasturia
speakers.bio:
Mayank is a Principal Solutions Architect – Cloud & AI at Precisely, where he leads the design and delivery of cloud-native and AI-powered Location Intelligence solutions for Fortune 500 enterprises. With deep expertise spanning AWS, Azure, and GCP, he specializes in modernizing legacy data platforms onto the Databricks ecosystem and integrating cutting-edge AI/ML technologies; both API-based LLMs and locally deployed models.
A trusted partner across the full pre-sales lifecycle, he guides enterprise clients from discovery through solution design, POC execution, and knowledge transfer. His work sits at the intersection of enterprise engineering and emerging AI, translating complex technology into measurable business outcomes.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Prophecy | Accelerating Investment Decisions with Specialized Claude Code
sessions.body: Portfolio managers at Waterfall Asset Management evaluate hundreds of loans daily and track performance on Databricks. But loan “tapes” arrive as spreadsheets in high volume and inconsistent formats across originating institutions, making bids dependent on time-consuming data cleaning and harmonization before standard metrics and dashboards can be computed. Waterfall Asset Management and Prophecy built a specialized Claude Code “harmonization” agent that automates onboarding into a common schema, requiring only a final validation pass where users review AI confidence, reasoning, and lineage and make any edits. In production, WFAM achieved 93% first-pass accuracy—now approaching 100%—reducing reliance on data experts and materially accelerating investment decisions.

speakers.name: Nabi, Shehzad
speakers.bio:
Shehzad Nabi is Chief Technology Officer at Waterfall Asset Management, overseeing all aspects of the firm's technology function.

Waterfall specializes in structured credit and asset-backed finance — markets defined by complexity and data intensity. The firm is building the technology capabilities to match: scaling how it works with data, accelerating investment workflows, and creating the operational foundation to grow with precision.

Prior to Waterfall, Shehzad spent over a decade at Goldman Sachs across London and New York in asset management and equities technology.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Prophecy | From Weeks to Minutes: Democratizing Marketing Analytics with Governed AI Agents on Databricks
sessions.body: Enterprise marketing analytics is constrained not by data, but by specialization and handoffs. Translating business intent into reusable strategies takes weeks across multiple teams. In partnership with Acxiom, Prophecy built a specialized AI agent that transforms business intent into production-grade, governed data pipelines. The agent learns schema, relationships and data distributions, understands business intent, automatically invokes analytical models (propensity, affinity, segmentation) and compiles deterministic Spark and SQL workflows executed on Databricks under Unity Catalog governance. What once required multiple teams and weeks of iteration is reduced to a swift, flexible, governed conversational workflow executed by a single marketer - no SQL, no handoffs. This architecture embeds institutional knowledge into reusable AI skills, enabling marketers while maintaining full auditability, lineage and reproducibility, fundamentally reshaping how marketing teams operate.

speakers.name: Ankur Jain
speakers.bio: Ankur is Chief Cloud and Data Modernization Officer at Acxiom. Ankur leads Acxiom's product and data engineering transformation by leveraging public cloud platforms, modern architectures, and artificial intelligence to enhance performance, scalability, and security. His focus is to help clients modernize their mar-tech stack, support their in-housing initiatives, and enable personalization at scale.

speakers.name: Bhaskar Dutta
speakers.bio: Bhaskar leads AI product management at Prophecy where he builds AI Applications for Marketing, Structured Finance and Auditing. He has been and engineering and product leader in data and AI startups for over 17 years and was one of the earliest adopters of Spark.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Qualytics | Your Agents Are Flying Blind: How to Close the Data Control Gap
sessions.body: Traditional quality frameworks validate data at rest, after ingestion, after transformation, and at the end of the pipeline. But AI agents don't follow that path. They query on demand, pulling from Unity Catalog tables that may have drifted, and they ingest new data from APIs and external sources that have never passed through a quality gate. This is the control gap: the space between where you enforce quality and where AI actually consumes data. In this session, Gorkem Sevinc (CEO, Qualytics) introduces validate-at-use, the principle that data quality should be enforced when an agent reads or receives data. He walks through a live Databricks lakehouse pipeline where an agent encounters stale-validated data and net-new inputs, then closes the gap in real time using Qualytics as the data control layer. You'll leave with a concrete architecture pattern for making your pipelines agent-ready by embedding validate-at-use controls directly into the agent loop.

speakers.name: Gorkem Sevinc
speakers.bio: Gorkem Sevinc is a technology leader and entrepreneur with extensive experience founding and scaling startups. He is the Co-Founder & CEO of Qualytics, the Data Control Layer for Trusted Context, an AI-augmented platform that scales data quality coverage while keeping humans in control of what "trusted" means. Previously, he co-founded Facet (financial services), Scene Health (digital health), and served as Managing Director of the Johns Hopkins Medicine Technology Innovation Center. Gorkem earned his B.S. in Computer Science from The University of Kansas and his MSE in Computer Science & Surgical Robotics from Johns Hopkins University. He lives in Annapolis, MD with his wife Dotti, dog Tilly, and cat Luna.

sessions.title: Sponsored By: Qubika | Building a Modern Data Foundation on Databricks: Lessons Learned From FanDuel Migration
sessions.body: Modern data platform migrations are no longer purely technical initiatives — they are business programs that reshape the foundation for operations, compliance, real-time decision making, and future AI adoption. In this session, Qubika shares how we partnered with FanDuel to migrate core workloads from Amazon Redshift to the Databricks lakehouse in a highly regulated, real-time environment. We cover the key engineering challenges, including rebuilding governance and metadata in Unity Catalog, validating data consistency at scale, and preserving developer velocity across large, multi-team migrations. We then show how these lessons led us to design an AI-powered Migration and Governance Agent — built natively on Databricks and powered by Lakebase as its persistent memory layer — to manage long-running workflows, reason over dependencies, and automate Databricks-ready governance artifacts. Attendees will leave with a practical blueprint to industrialize migrations and reduce risk.

speakers.name: Sebastian Diaz
speakers.bio: With over 15 years of experience in the technology space — including more than six years leading data and AI teams — I’m recognized as a thought leader in the field. I regularly speak at top industry events such as the DAMA-Wisconsin Expo, MinneAnalytica in Minneapolis, ConnectIA, Disney’s Data & Analytics Conference (DDAC), and Databricks Meetups. My talks on generative AI, large language models, and data-driven innovation are designed to offer clarity and direction to CTOs and senior technology leaders navigating today’s evolving landscape.

sessions.title: Sponsored By: Quest | From Back Office to Boardroom: The New Era of Data Modeling for AI
sessions.body: For decades, data modeling lived quietly in the back office — essential, but overlooked. AI has changed that. Today, data modeling is no longer a technical afterthought — it is the difference between AI that works and AI that hallucinates, breaks, or fails compliance. Yet most organizations are still applying yesterday’s modeling practices to tomorrow’s AI problems. This session challenges that mindset. We’ll explore how data modeling is evolving into a strategic, AI-era discipline — powering trusted data products, enabling semantic clarity for GenAI, and more! This is not your grandfather’s data modeling. Learn how modern approaches — augmented by automation, metadata intelligence, and AI — are transforming modeling from static documentation into a dynamic, living system that drives business outcomes. See how solutions like Quest Erwin Data Modeler help organizations move faster, reduce risk, and turn data models into a competitive advantage in the age of AI.

speakers.name: Yetkin Ozkucur
speakers.bio: As the leader of a global solutions team, and over 25 years’ experience in this space, I have the privilege of working at the intersection of technology, business strategy, and customer success. My focus is on delivering innovative, solution-oriented strategies that empower organizations to unlock the full value of their data. With a deep passion for data, AI and data intelligence, I’m committed to helping enterprises transform how they manage, understand, and leverage information. I thrive in roles where technology meets impact—where the right solutions can drive better decisions, accelerate growth, and build trust.

sessions.title: Sponsored By: Quest | From Model to Marketplace: A Better Way to Manage Data End-To-End
sessions.body: Most organizations don't have a data problem — they have a data management gap. The distance between a well-defined data model and a trusted, self-service data product that business teams can actually use is where value goes to die — this session closes that gap. We'll walk through how Quest's portfolio of solutions drives a complete data management journey — from foundational modeling through integration, quality, cataloging, and all the way to publishing data products into an internal marketplace for self-service access inside Databricks. The result: data that arrives in Databricks already understood, already trusted, and ready to drive real business outcomes — with zero-downtime transitions and no disruption along the way. Whether you're an executive accountable for data value, an engineer building and managing pipelines, or a business user tired of waiting on IT to get you what you need — this session will show you a better way to manage data end-to-end.

speakers.name: Sue  Laine
speakers.bio: Sue is the Director of Sales Strategists/DI Thought Leader for the Erwin Data Intelligence product line. A thought leader in the application of technology and business process to solve real business problems, Sue has over 20 years’ experience working with metadata on the buy side as a customer and the sell side as a vendor, including implementation, showcasing, and program support. She has worked to structure and drive enterprise data management programs. Additionally, Sue has extensive support experience to sustain these initiatives within an organization. She has supported a wide range of clients, including financial, insurance, healthcare, manufacturing and e-Commerce with a general need to provide data-driven business practices. Sue is responsible for launching and guiding Quests Data Intelligence solution's superior Modeling/Data Intelligence technology in fresh, modern offerings that deliver excellent value for today's challenging business demands.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Quest Software | From Logical Model to Databricks: Automating Data Product Publishing at Scale
sessions.body: What if data products could be built in days, not months — and deployed directly into Databricks? We'll introduce the Automated Data Product Factory (ADPF): a model-first framework that transforms how organizations define, govern, and publish data products at scale. We’ll walk through a live use case showing how to automate data product publishing into Databricks and Unity Catalog, using logical specifications to accelerate time-to-value across your data landscape — without rebuilding everything from scratch on each platform. You'll walk away understanding: How the ADPF generates logical data product specs How those specs power automated publishing into Databricks & Unity Catalog What a model-first strategy means for governance at scale Best for: CDOs, CDAOs, and data leaders accountable for AI-ready data; Data Engineers and Architects scaling delivery across hybrid environments; and Business Users ready to create data products tied to real outcomes, without going to IT.

speakers.name: Sue  Laine
speakers.bio: Sue is the Director of Sales Strategists/DI Thought Leader for the Erwin Data Intelligence product line. A thought leader in the application of technology and business process to solve real business problems, Sue has over 20 years’ experience working with metadata on the buy side as a customer and the sell side as a vendor, including implementation, showcasing, and program support. She has worked to structure and drive enterprise data management programs. Additionally, Sue has extensive support experience to sustain these initiatives within an organization. She has supported a wide range of clients, including financial, insurance, healthcare, manufacturing and e-Commerce with a general need to provide data-driven business practices. Sue is responsible for launching and guiding Quests Data Intelligence solution's superior Modeling/Data Intelligence technology in fresh, modern offerings that deliver excellent value for today's challenging business demands.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Red Hat | Why AI Evaluation Breaks at Scale — and How to Fix It End-to-End
sessions.body: Most teams evaluate AI in pieces — one script for agent behavior, another for safety, another for adversarial testing — with no shared results, no audit trail, and no defensible answer to "is this ready to deploy?" The accumulation of disconnected tools isn't a gap you can close by adding another tool. It's an organizational and architectural failure, and it compounds as models and agents move into regulated or high-stakes environments. This session confronts the gap directly. We leverage Evaluation-Driven Development (EDD): a structured methodology that connects behavioral, safety, and adversarial evaluation layers into a single, reproducible workflow — with an audit trail your compliance team can actually use and demonstrate it with open-source tooling that integrates with MLflow. Whether you own the model, the platform, or the risk, this session gives you a shared framework for answering the question that matters: Is this AI-enabled capability ready to be deployed?

speakers.name: Carlos Condado
speakers.bio: Carlos Condado is a Senior Product Marketing Manager for Red Hat AI, where he helps enterprises navigate the path from AI experimentation to production-scale deployment. He partners across engineering, product, and go-to-market teams to shape strategy for Red Hat's open AI portfolio, with a particular focus on inference infrastructure, MLOps, and the operational disciplines required to run AI reliably at scale. Carlos brings a cross-functional perspective from prior work spanning data analytics, integration, and cybersecurity.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Reducto | Better Agents with Better Data: How leading AI teams ingest unstructured data at scale
sessions.body: As AI agents become more capable, their performance is increasingly bottlenecked not by model quality but by the quality of data they consume. This talk explores how leading AI teams across startups and Fortune 10 enterprises tackle the challenge of ingesting unstructured data at scale — from complex PDFs and scanned documents to messy real-world files — and shares practical patterns for building more reliable agents through better data pipelines.

speakers.name: Adit Abraham
speakers.bio: Adit Abraham is the co-founder and CEO of Reducto, a platform that helps leading AI teams transform unstructured documents into structured, reliable data for production pipelines. With industry-leading accuracy, Reducto powers organizations ranging from Fortune 10 companies to Harvey and beyond—processing billions of pages each month and redefining AI ingestion for enterprise-scale intelligence.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Reltio | From Fragmented Records to Trusted Context: Unified 360 Profiles for Databricks
sessions.body: Enterprise AI struggles when customer, product, supplier and other core data remains fragmented across systems. In this lightning talk, Mike Frasca, VP of Product Management at Reltio, will show how Reltio Data Sharing with Databricks gives teams live, governed access to trusted 360 profiles via Delta Sharing — bringing unified entities, relationships, interactions and calculated attributes into Databricks seamlessly. The result is trusted context that improves AI accuracy, accelerates BI, analytics/ML and GenAI workloadsm, and preserves governance, lineage and auditing through Unity Catalog.

speakers.name: Mike Frasca
speakers.bio: Mike is VP of Product Management at Reltio, responsible for overseeing strategic technical guidance to all customer facing Reltio teams and assisting with long term product strategy and innovation at Reltio.  Prior to joining Reltio in 2016, Mike led the technical side of MDM implementation teams at multiple consulting firms and was a principal architect at IBM and Initiate Systems.  He has worked on some of the most complex MDM implementations and led data architecture designs used by Fortune 100 companies today.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Retool | Responding to Signals That Drive High-Stakes Decisions with Databricks Genie
sessions.body: Conversational AI is making it much easier to understand what’s changing in your data. The harder problem now is acting on the signals that shape high-stakes business decisions early enough to reduce missed targets, operational disruption, or compliance exposure. In this lightning session, we’ll demo how those signals can move from explanation to action inside Databricks Genie Spaces using Retool agents directly on governed enterprise data. A question in Genie becomes a shared response that brings in the right stakeholders and triggers follow-up steps across systems directly from the same workspace. You’ll see how acting on signals earlier can help your teams adjust plans sooner, resolve issues faster, and influence the decisions that matter most.

speakers.name: Tom Konewka
speakers.bio: Tom Konewka is a Strategic Solutions Architect at Retool, a platform to rapidly design and deploy software. His diverse background in infrastructure and applications with roles at Cisco and AWS over 10 years have allowed him to guide Enterprises through digital transformations at scale. Today he helps organizations design and deliver AI powered applications and agents.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Retool | The Last Mile of Enterprise AI Adoption: How Reckitt Operationalizes AI on the Lakehouse
sessions.body: Reckitt operates a global portfolio of health and hygiene brands across more than 60 countries, including brands like Lysol and Durex, where speed, agility, and efficiency are critical to staying competitive. After building its Gen AI platform on Databricks, the company set out to deliver faster, more actionable consumer insights to marketing teams as part of a broader business transformation, ultimately reducing insight delivery time by up to 60 percent. In this session, Retool shares how Reckitt unified marketing data across sources and embedded Gen AI directly into governed marketing workflows on the Databricks Lakehouse, replacing manual reporting with execution paths that scale. Attendees will gain practical insights into the business and architectural decisions, integration patterns, and governance approaches used to embed Gen AI into governed workflows at enterprise scale.

speakers.name: Steve Miller
speakers.bio:
Steve is a business development executive with a focus in driving strategic alliances and partnerships. Steve's focus transcends on-paper relationships by working closely with partners to develop mutually beneficial relationships and integrations that lead to ecstatic customers and to growth for all platforms.

Steve also has experience in territory management and consulting around emerging technology solutions, especially cloud-based infrastructure and application solutions. Through these efforts, Steve developed unique expertise in helping customers strengthen their technology portfolio.

speakers.name: Tom Konewka
speakers.bio: Tom Konewka is a Strategic Solutions Architect at Retool, a platform to rapidly design and deploy software. His diverse background in infrastructure and applications with roles at Cisco and AWS over 10 years have allowed him to guide Enterprises through digital transformations at scale. Today he helps organizations design and deliver AI powered applications and agents.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: RowZero | AI Spreadsheets and the Modern Data Stack: Security, Governance and Self-Serve Analytics
sessions.body: Your enterprise data is in the cloud, but most business teams still work in Excel, disconnected from Databricks and other cloud systems. Teams export CSVs of data out of cloud tools and immediately lose the scale, security and live connectivity of the cloud. In the transition to the cloud, most organizations have overlooked the most important tool — the spreadsheet. This session explores the role spreadsheets currently play and why making the spreadsheet a first-class citizen in your cloud data stack is a big opportunity. If your organization has modernized its data stack but still relies on legacy spreadsheet workflows, this talk will show how to bridge the gap and give business users secure access to Databricks data in a governed, cloud spreadsheet that is AI-enabled and scales with your data size.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: S&P Global | Leveraging Genie to Remove Friction From Exploratory Data Analysis (EDA)
sessions.body: S&P Capital IQ Workbench, powered by Databricks, allows users to easily test and evaluate S&P Global data. During this session we'll discuss how Databricks Genie further removes friction from exploratory data analysis (EDA) for both business and technical evaluators. Business users can ask natural-language questions and receive curated answers, tables, and visualizations, without writing code. Technical users can validate findings, extend analyses, and operationalize workflows in the same secure notebook environment. Attendees will learn how natural-language querying accelerates time to insight, increases engagement (measured by logins/queries run), and improves customer workflow understanding (feedback from what questions clients ask). We’ll close with success metrics and examples of how this approach shortens sales cycles and improves conversion beyond today’s baseline.

speakers.name: Onik Kurktchian
speakers.bio: Onik is the Head of the S&P Global Marketplace Workbench. He leads product development for Analytical Platforms and Services at S&P Global Market Intelligence, a division of S&P Global. In his role, he is responsible for creating products and services that enable data exploration and workflow solutions across client segments. Previously, he has worked as a Product Specialist across multiple S&P Global products within Desktop & Feed Solutions.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Safe Software | All Data, Any AI: Building MCP-Ready Ecosystems with FME
sessions.body:
Most AI initiatives can reason, but few can act. Your Databricks lakehouse has the data, but not the enterprise connections to put AI to work. Without them, AI remains a passive chatbot, not an autonomous agent. Bridging this gap has meant writing brittle, hard-to-scale glue code. MCP and FME solve this with a blueprint for a scalable AI Tool Factory. Safe Software CEO Don Murray shares how FME uses MCP to transform complex workflows into plug-and-play tools for any AI. You’ll learn how to:

  • Eliminate technical debt: Deploy pipelines into governed MCP tools without writing code.
  • Bridge the data gap: Connect AI agents to spatial data, legacy systems and real-time feeds the lakehouse can’t easily reach.
  • Deploy at scale: Quickly build, test and ship AI tools.
  • Actionize the lakehouse: Turn static insights into autonomous enterprise actions.

 

Learn the all data, Any-AI, MCP-enabled strategy to turn your Databricks platform into an actionable AI powerhouse.

speakers.name: Don Murray
speakers.bio:
Don Murray is a Canadian entrepreneur, co-founder and CEO of Safe Software, a company at the forefront of data integration. His entrepreneurial journey began in 1993 when Safe Software was launched, driven by a vision to enhance data integration technology.
Don Murray's visionary leadership and dedication to innovation have been instrumental in driving Safe Software's growth and success. His commitment to developing solutions that bring life to data continues to propel the company forward as a leader in data integration solutions.

sessions.title: Sponsored by: Salesforce | How Salesforce Gets More Done Daily with Slack and Slackbot
